Su.6.42.10 hṛtkukṣiśūlaṃ mukhakaṇṭhaśoṣo vāyornirodho viṣamāgnitā ca/
te te vikārāḥ pavanātmakāśca bhavanti gulme+anilasaṃbhave tu//
pittasya liṅgānyakhilāni yāni pittātmake tāni bhavanti gulme//
kaphasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni bhavanti gulme kaphasaṃbhave tu//
Su.6.42.13 sarvātmakaḥ sarvavikārayuktaḥ so+asādhya uktaḥ kṣatajaṃ pravakṣye/
navaprasūtā+ahitabhojanā yā yā cāmagarbhaṃ visṛjedṛtau† vā//
Su.6.42.14 vāyurhi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ sarujaṃ sadāham/
paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpyaparaṃ nibodha//
Su.6.42.15 na spandate nodarameti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni ca garbhiṇīnām/
Su.6.42.22 ānūpaudakamajjāno vasā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi/
Su.6.42.23 jāṅgalaikaśaphānāṃ tu vasā sarpiśca paittike/
Su.6.42.34 dadhi sauvīrakaṃ sarpiḥ kvāthau mudgakulatthajau/
Su.6.42.35 sauvarcalaṃ sarjikāṃ ca devadārvatha saindhavam/
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vā+api ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam//
tasya mātrāṃ pibeddadhnā surayā sarpiṣā+api vā//
Su.6.42.47 citrakaṃ ca jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam/
Su.6.42.50 lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syādanavo guḍaḥ/
Su.6.42.52 hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca dāruṇam/
Su.6.42.53 gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā haret/
Su.6.42.54 kaṭutrikasamāyuktā hitāḥ pāne tu gulminām/
peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthāḥ saṃskṛtā rasāḥ//
Su.6.42.55 khalāḥ sapañcamūlāśca gulmināṃ bhojane hitāḥ/
Su.6.42.60 kṛtvā pāyau vidhātavyā vartayo maricottarāḥ/
Su.6.42.62 ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na nirūhayet/
Su.6.42.63 gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām/
Su.6.42.64 evaṃ pīlūni †bhṛṣṭāni pibet salavaṇāni tu/
Su.6.42.65 yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle prayojitā/
Su.6.42.70 yavānīṃ ca haridrāṃ ca viḍaṅgānyamlavetasam/
Su.6.42.73 yathākramaṃ vimiśrāṃśca dvandve sarvāṃśca sarvaje/
Su.6.42.76 na khādedālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca/
Su.6.42.77 nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca sacikitsitam/
Su.6.42.80 vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ koṣṭhe śūlaṃ saṃjanayedbhṛśam/
Su.6.42.84 tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca/
Su.6.42.88 śūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ cikitsāṃ tu nibodha me/
Su.6.42.89 tasya śūlābhipannasya sveda eva sukhāvahaḥ/
Su.6.42.90 trivṛcchākena vā snigdhamuṣṇaṃ bhiñjīta bhojanam/
Su.6.42.91 vaihaṅgāṃśca rasān snigdhān jāṅgalān śūlapīḍitaḥ/
Su.6.42.92 surā sauvīrakaṃ cukraṃ mastūdaśvittathā dadhi/
Su.6.42.95 madyena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva praśāmyati/
Su.6.42.96 pippalyaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ saindhavaṃ ceti cūrṇayet/
tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā//
Su.6.42.98 tathā badarayūṣeṇa bhāvitāni punaḥ punaḥ/
Su.6.42.99 saha dāḍimasāreṇa vartiḥ kāryā bhiṣagjitā/
Su.6.42.100 guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā punaḥ/
Su.6.42.104 sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ naraḥ/
Su.6.42.106 guḍaḥ śāliryavāḥ kṣīraṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ virecanam/
Su.6.42.107 rasān seveta pittaghnān pittalāni vivarjayet/
Su.6.42.109 aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya ca/
Su.6.42.110 rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syādanyāścoṣṇāḥ kriyā hitāḥ/
Su.6.42.111 pāṭhāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ tathā kaṭukarohiṇīm/
Su.6.42.113 dadyācchṛgālavinnāṃ ca sahadevāṃ tathaiva ca/
Su.6.42.114 etat saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet/
Su.6.42.115 vātikaṃ paittikaṃ vā+api ślaiṣmikaṃ sānnipātikam/
Su.6.42.116 pippalī svarjikākṣāro yavāścitraka eva ca/
Su.6.42.120 tatra puṣkaramūlāni hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam/
saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet//
sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam//
Su.6.42.122 bījapūrakasāraṃ vā payasā saha sādhitam/
Su.6.42.123 bhojayeccāpi payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā/
Su.6.42.124 tadā+asya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na pacyate/
Su.6.42.125 naivāsane na śayane †tiṣṭhan vā labhate sukham/
Su.6.42.127 nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam/
Su.6.42.128 bṛhatyāḥ kaṇṭakāryāśca kvāthaṃ śūlaharaṃ pibet/
Su.6.42.129 kuṭajasya ca bījāni sadyaḥśūlaharāṇi tu/
Su.6.42.136 vāyuḥ prakupito yasya rūkṣāhārasya dehinaḥ/
malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam//
Su.6.42.137 śūlaṃ saṃjanayaṃstīvraṃ srotāṃsyāvṛtya tasya hi/
dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣimādāya jāyate//
Su.6.42.138 sarvatra vardhate kṣipraṃ bhramannatha† saghoṣavān/
pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate//
Su.6.42.140 kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu jānatā/
Su.6.42.142 atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ gate/
Su.6.42.143 avipākagataṃ hyannaṃ śūlaṃ tīvraṃ karotyati/
Su.6.42.145 vamanaṃ laṅghanaṃ svedaḥ pācanaṃ phalavartayaḥ/
kṣārāścūrṇāni† guṭikāḥ śasyante śūlanāśanāḥ// gulmāvasthāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā yathāvat sarvaśūlinām//
Su.6.43.4 dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ/
kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate//
Su.6.43.5 caturvidhaḥ sa doṣaiḥ syāt kṛmibhiśca† pṛthak pṛthak/
nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate+api ca//
dhūmāyanaṃ ca mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca//
Su.6.43.9 utkleśaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlo hṛllāsakastamaḥ/
kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ//
Su.6.43.18 cūrṇaṃ tu pāyayetoktaṃ vātaje bhojayecca† tam/
Su.6.44.3 vyavāyamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnamatīva tīkṣṇam/
niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣāstvaci pāṇḍubhāvam//
sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāvo yato+adhiko+ataḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ//
Su.6.44.10 sarvātmake sarvamidaṃ vyavasyed vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyāḥ/
yo hyāmayānte sahasā+annamamlamadyādapathyāni ca tasya pittam//
Su.6.44.11 karoti pāṇḍuṃ vadanaṃ viśeṣāt †pūrveritau tandribalakṣayau ca/
bhedastu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃstatra ca parvabhedaḥ//
śophastathā kaṇṭhagato+abalatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca//
Su.6.44.14 sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ ghṛtenordhvamadhaśca śuddham/
Su.6.44.15 pibedghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yantraiphalaṃ tailvakameva vā+api/
Su.6.44.16 mūtre nikumbhārdhapalaṃ vipācya pibedabhīkṣṇaṃ kuḍavārdhamātram/
Su.6.44.18 ahrecca doṣān bahuśo+alpamātrān śvayeddhi doṣeṣvatinirhṛteṣu/
dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī//
Su.6.44.19 ubhe bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi sakākamācīm/
Su.6.44.20 tat pāṇḍutāṃ hantyupayujyamānaṃ kṣīeṇa vā māgadhikā yathāgni/
hitaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhujaṃ† kaṣāyaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā+avalihyāt//
Su.6.44.22 ājaṃ śakṛtsyāt† kuḍavapramāṇaṃ viḍaṃ haridrā lavaṇottamaṃ ca/
Su.6.44.24 bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca guḍaśca mukhyaḥ/
Su.6.44.25 sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi sukhāmbunā vā/
mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre//
Su.6.44.26 mūlaṃ balācitrakayoḥ pibedvā pāṇḍvāmayārto+akṣasamaṃ hitāśī/
sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam//
Su.6.44.27 nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī/
śālādikaṃ cāpyatha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunā+avalihyāt//
cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śume ca//
jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayenmokṣakaje samudge//
Su.6.44.30 hantyeṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ saśothamugrāmapi kāmalāṃ ca/
saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī//
Su.6.44.31 kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat syādrajanīvimiśram/
dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye †mūtrayutaṃ pibedvā//
Su.6.44.32 mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasaṃprayuktaṃ māsaṃ pibedvā+api hi lohakiṭṭam/
Su.6.44.33 vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunā+acireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt/
sindhūdbhavaṃ vā+agnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛdeva taptam//
Su.6.44.34 lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaśca taptvā nirvāpya mūtre bahuśastathaiva/
Su.6.44.35 yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ peyamudaśvitā tat/
takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate+analaṃ ca//
Su.6.44.36 drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ lāgharake(lāghavake) hitaṃ ca/
Su.6.44.37 snigdhān rasānāmalakairupetān kolānvitān vā+api hi jāṅgalānām/
seveta śophābhihitāṃśca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃśca nityam//
Su.6.44.39 anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ tathā+anteṣu ca madhyaśūnam/
gude ca śephasyatha muṣkaśūnaṃ† pratāmyamānaṃ ca visaṃjñakalpam//
Su.6.44.40 vivarjayet pāṇḍukinaṃ yaśo+arthī tathā+atisārajvarapīḍitaṃ ca//
Su.6.45.4 nityamabhyasato duṣṭo rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet/
Su.6.45.5 tataḥ pravartate raktamūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhā+api vā/
Su.6.45.9 daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadāstandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne vidāhastvadhṛtirapi sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā/
tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ śirasi ca †davanaṃ pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte+avipāko viratirapi rate raktapittopasargāḥ//
Su.6.45.10 māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitamiva ca yat kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ† yakṛdiva yadi vā pakvajambūphalābham/
yat kṛṣṇaṃ yacca nīlaṃ bhṛśamatikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārāstadvarjyaṃ raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yacca tulyaṃ vibhāti//
Su.6.45.14 laṅghitasya tataḥ peyāṃ vidadhyāt svalpataṇḍulām/
tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṣi vividhāni ca//
Su.6.45.16 payāṃsi śītāni rasāśca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāśca saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ/
Su.6.45.17 hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam/
himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāśca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni ca raktapittinām//
Su.6.45.20 lihyācca dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān madhudvitīyān sitakarṇikasya† ca/
hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyānyapi tadguṇānyatha//
Su.6.45.22 yojayitvā kṣipedrātrāvākāśe sotpalaṃ tu tat/
Su.6.45.25 candnaṃ madhukaṃ rodhramevameva samaṃ pibet/
Su.6.45.29 palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam/
vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā//
Su.6.45.30 drākṣāmuśīrāṇyatha padmakaṃ sitā pṛthakpalāṃśānyudake samāvapet/
sthitaṃ niśāṃ tadrudhirāmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vā+ambusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ//
Su.6.45.31 turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā/
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām//
Su.6.45.33 pathyāmahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāttathā śoṇitapittarogī/
Su.6.45.34 pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyāt pittasṛjo vegamudīrṇamāśu/
Su.6.45.35 puṣpāṇi śigrośca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ śoṇitapittaroge/
Su.6.45.36 jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ pittamasṛk ca yogāḥ/
mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena//
Su.6.45.37 ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā/
drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā//
Su.6.45.38 śītopacāraṃ madhuraṃ ca kuryādviśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittaroge/
Su.6.45.39 kṣīreṇa cāsthāpanamagryamuktaṃ hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpyanuvāsanārtham/
Su.6.45.42 virekayoge tvati caiva śasyate vāmyaśca rakte vijite balānvitaḥ//
Su.6.45.43 evaṃvidhā uttarabāstayaśca mūtrāśayasthe rudhire vidheyāḥ/
pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryādvidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam//
Su.6.45.45 trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ śoṇite+api ca sarvaśaḥ/
Su.6.46.5 hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ saṃjñānāśo balasya ca/
moho mūrccheti tāṃ prāhuḥ ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā//
Su.6.46.8 vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca/
Su.6.46.10 tasmādraktasya gandhena mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavāḥ/
gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat//
Su.6.46.14 sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā vyajanānilāśca/
śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsvanivāritāni//
kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni//
Su.6.46.16 siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā jāṅgalajā rasāśca/
tathā yavā lohitaśālayaśca mūrcchāsu pathyāśca sadā satīnāḥ//
Su.6.46.17 bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricānyuśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ ca pibet samāni/
śītena toyena† bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām//
Su.6.46.18 kuryācca nāsāvadanāvarodhaṃ kṣīraṃ pibedvā+apyatha mānuṣīṇām/
mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekairjayedabhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ//
Su.6.46.19 †harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā/
Su.6.46.20 pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni śamaṃ nayanti/
Su.6.46.21 saṃnyastasaṃjño bhṛśaduścikitsyo jñeyastadā buddhimatā manuṣyāḥ/
ābhiḥ kriyābhiśca na labdhasaṃjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaśca varjyaḥ//
Su.6.47.3 madyamuṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva ca/
rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca//
Su.6.47.6 tadamlaṃ rasataḥ proktaṃ laghu rocanadīpanam/
vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ//
Su.6.47.10 madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati/
Su.6.47.11 tryavasthaśca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo+atha paścimaḥ/
Su.6.47.14 nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam/
Su.6.47.15 kruddhena bhītena pipāsitena śokābhitaptena bubhukṣitena/
uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān//
Su.6.47.19 śleṣmātmake vamathuśītakaphaprasekāḥ sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasaṃpat/
Su.6.47.20 liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇāṃ rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam/
Su.6.47.21 jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni/
Su.6.47.22 dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ/
Su.6.47.23 jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavā+api nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprame ca/
hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ bhajante//
Su.6.47.24 teṣāṃ nivāraṇamidaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ vyaktābhidhānamakhilena vidhiṃ nibodha/
Su.6.47.25 pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhirvā sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya/
Su.6.47.26 seveta vā phalarasopahitān rasādīnānūpavargapiśitānyapi gandhavanti/
Su.6.47.27 pītvā ca madyamapi cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇamavasthitamullikhecca/
lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃśca pibedanamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān//
Su.6.47.28 pānātyaye kaphakṛte kaphamullikhecca madyena bimbividulodakasaṃyutena/
seveta tiktakaṭukāṃśca rasānudārān yūṣāṃśca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya//
Su.6.47.29 pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni śleṣmaghnamanyadapi yacca niratyayaṃ syāt/
kuryācca sarvamatha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ ddvandvodbhave dvayamavekṣya yathāpradhānam//
Su.6.47.30 sāmānyamanyadapi yacca samagramagryaṃ vakṣyāmi yacca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca/
Su.6.47.32 piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ jalaiśca vitaredamalaiḥ suśītaiḥ/
Su.6.47.33 drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtaistatpānakaṃ śuci sugandhi narairniṣevyam/
piṣṭvā pibecca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlamasakṛt trapuṣībhavaṃ yat//
Su.6.47.34 †kārpāsinīmatha ca nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca/
Su.6.47.35 tadbījapūrakarasāyutamāśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ paramade tvacirāt karoti/
Su.6.47.36 sauvarcalāyutamudārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito+avasekaḥ//
vipācya tasyāñjalinā vameddhi madyaṃ pibeccāhni gate tvajīrṇe//
Su.6.47.39 hṛdyaiḥ khaḍairapi ca bhojanamatra śastaṃ drākṣākapitthaphaladāḍimapānakaṃ yat/
Su.6.47.40 kharjūravetrakakarīraparūṣakeṣu† drākṣātrivṛtsu ca kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā/
Su.6.47.43 pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ sukhāśca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ†/
drākṣāṃ ca kṛṣṇāmatha keśaraṃ ca kṣīre samāloḍya pibet †sukhepsuḥ//
Su.6.47.47 bhavecca madyena tu yena pātitaḥ prakāmapītena surāsavādinā/
Su.6.47.48 yathā narendropahatasya kasyacidbhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ/
dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ//
Su.6.47.53 pakvamabhyañjane śreṣṭhaṃ seke kvāthaśca śītalaḥ/
Su.6.47.54 pānakāni suśītāni hṛdyāni surabhīṇi ca/
Su.6.47.55 śītaṃ vidhānamata ūrdhvamahaṃ pravakṣye dāhapraśāntikaramṛddhimatāṃ narāṇām/
bhinnotpalojjvalahime śayane śayīta patreṣu vā sajalabinduṣu padminīnām//
tatrainamamburuhapatrasamaiḥ spṛśantyaḥ śītaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ stanaiśca//
Su.6.47.60 toyāvagāhakuśalā madhurasvabhāvāḥ saṃharṣayeyurabalāḥ sukalaiḥ† pralāpaiḥ/
Su.6.47.62 tasmin gṛhe kamalareṇvaruṇe śayīta yatnāhṛtānilavikampitapuṣpadāmni/
Su.6.47.63 udbhinnanīlanalināmburuhākarāṇāṃ candrodayasya ca kathāḥ śṛṇuyānmanojñāḥ/
Su.6.47.64 tā enamārdravasanāḥ saha saṃviśeyuḥ śliṣṭvā+avalāḥ śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭyaḥ//
Su.6.47.65 harṣayeyurnaraṃ nāryaḥ svaguṇai rahasi sthitāḥ/
Su.6.47.69 apraśāmyati dāhe ca rasaistṛptasya jāṅgalaiḥ/
Su.6.47.70 pittajvarasamaḥ pittāt sa cāpyasya vidhirhitaḥ/
sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātreṣu dehiṣu//
madyāni hṛdyānyatha gandhavanti pītāni sadyaḥ śamayanti tṛṣṇām//
piben surāṃ naiva labheta rogān †manonuvighnaṃ ca madaṃ na yāti//
Su.6.48.3 satataṃ yaḥ pibedvāri na tṛptimadhigacchati/
punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet//
dhātukṣayāllaṅghanasūryatāpāt pittaṃ ca vātaśca bhṛśaṃ pravṛddhau//
Su.6.48.5 srotāṃsi saṃdūṣayataḥ sametau yānyambuvāhīni śarīriṇāṃ hi/
Su.6.48.6 tisraḥ smṛtāstāḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāttathā+anyā++āmasamudbhavā ca/
syāt saptamī bhaktanimittajā tu nibodha† liṅgānyanupūrvaśastu//
srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītabhiradbhiśca vivṛddhimeti//
śītābhikāṅkṣā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridhūpanaṃ ca//
Su.6.48.10 kaphāvṛtābhyāmanilānalābhyāṃ kapho+api śuṣkaḥ prakaroti tṛṣṇām†/
nidrā gurutvaṃ madhurāsyatā ca tayā+arditaḥ† śuṣyati cātimātram//
kaphātmikāyāṃ gurugātratā ca śākhāsu śophastvavipāka eva/
etāni rūpāṇi bhavanti tasyāṃ tayā+arditaḥ kāṅkṣati nāti cāmbhaḥ//
Su.6.48.12 kṣatasya rukśoṇitanirgamābhyāṃ tṛṣṇā caturthī kṣatajā †matā tu/
tayā+abhibhūtasya niśādināni gacchanti duḥkhaṃ pibato+api toyam//
Su.6.48.13 †rasakṣayādyā kṣayajā matā sā tayā+arditaḥ śuṣyati dahyate ca/
atyarthamākāṅkṣati cāpi toyaṃ tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ//
Su.6.48.14 rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyāmaśeṣeṇa bhiṣagvyavasyet/
Su.6.48.15 snigdhaṃ tathā+amlaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ †gurvannamevātitṛṣāṃ karoti/
Su.6.48.16 tṛṣṇābhivṛddhāvudare ca pūrṇe taṃ vāmayenmāgadhikodakena/
Su.6.48.17 tisraḥ prayogairiha sannivāryāḥ śītaiśca samyagrasavīryajātaiḥ/
jalaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ śamayettu tṛṣṇāṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ himaṃ vā//
Su.6.48.19 pañcāṅgikāḥ pañcagaṇā ya uktāsteṣvambu† siddhaṃ prathame gaṇe vā/
pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ manujo†+acireṇa tṛṣo vimucyeta hi vātajāyāḥ//
Su.6.48.20 pittaghnavargaistu kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ saśarkaraḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ suśītaḥ/
pītastṛṣāṃ pittakṛtāṃ nihanti kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ vā+apyatha jīvanīyaiḥ//
Su.6.48.22 sarvāsu tṛṣṇāsvathavā+api paittaṃ kuryādvidhiṃ tena† hi tā na santi/
Su.6.48.23 vargasya siddhasya ca sārivādeḥ pātavyamambhaḥ śiśiraṃ tṛṣārtaiḥ/
Su.6.48.24 lājotpalośīrakucandanāni dattvā pravāte niśi vāsayettu/
Su.6.48.25 drākṣāpragāḍhaṃ ca hitāya vaidyastṛṣṇārditebhyo vitarennarebhyaḥ/
Su.6.48.26 kuryāt kaṣāyaṃ ca yatheritena† madhūkapuṣpādiṣu cāpareṣu/
rājādanakṣīrikapītaneṣu ṣaṭ pānakānyatra hitāni ca syuḥ//
Su.6.48.28 kṣayotthitāṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ nihanyānmāṃsodakaṃ vā madhukodakaṃ vā/
gurvannajātāṃ vamanairjayecca kṣayādṛte sarvakṛtāṃ ca tṛṣṇām//
Su.6.48.30 śramodbhavāṃ māṃsaraso nihanti guḍodakaṃ vā+apyathavā+api manthaḥ/
Su.6.48.31 yā snehapītasya bhavecca tṛṣṇā tatroṣṇamambhaḥ prapibenmanuṣyaḥ/
madyodbhavāmardhajalaṃ nihanti madyaṃ tṛṣāṃ yā+api ca madyapasya//
Su.6.48.32 †tṛṣṇodbhavāṃ hanti jalaṃ suśītaṃ saśarkaraṃ sekṣurasaṃ tathā+ambhaḥ/
svaiḥ svaiḥ kaṣāyairvamanāni tāsāṃ tathā jvaroktāni ca pācanāni//
Su.6.48.33 lepāvagāhau pariṣecanāni kuryāttathā śītagṛhāṇi cāpi/
saṃśodhanaṃ kṣīrarasau ghṛtāni sarvāsu lehānmadhurān himāṃśca//
pūrvarūpaṃ mataṃ chardyā yathāsvaṃ ca vibhāvayet//
śrāntaḥ saghoṣaṃ bahuśaḥ kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe+adhikaṃ sā+anilajā vamistu//
Su.6.49.10 yo+amlaṃ bhṛśaṃ vā kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā/
Su.6.49.11 yo hṛṣṭaromā madhuraṃ prabhūtaṃ śuklaṃ himaṃ sāndrakaphānuviddham/
Su.6.49.12 sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti yasyāṃ sā sarvadoṣaprabhavā matā tu/
bībhatsajā dauhṛdajā++āmajā ca †sātmyaprakopāt kṛmijā ca †yā hi/
sā pañcamī †tāṃ ca vibhāvayettu doṣocchrayeṇaiva yathoktamādau//
Su.6.49.18 yathāsvaṃ ca kaṣāyāṇi jvaraghnāni prayojayet/
Su.6.49.20 pibedvā vyaktasindhūtthaṃ phalāmlaṃ vaiṣkiraṃ rasam/
Su.6.49.24 kṛtaṃ guḍūcyā vidhivat kaṣāyaṃ himasaṃjñitam/
Su.6.49.28 samākṣikā madhurasā pītā vā taṇḍulāmbunā/
Su.6.49.33 dhātrīrase candanaṃ vā ghṛṣṭaṃ mudgadalāmbunā/
Su.6.49.34 sakṣaudrāṃ śālilājānāṃ yavagūṃ vā pibennaraḥ/
Su.6.49.35 jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śubhāni† pānakāni ca/
sa ghoṣavānāśu hinastyasūn yatastatastu hikketi bhiṣagbhirucyate//
Su.6.50.7 annajāṃ yamalāṃ kṣudrāṃ gambhīrāṃ mahatīṃ tathā/
vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi//
Su.6.50.10 hikkayatyūrdhvago bhūtvā tāṃ vidyādannajāṃ bhiṣak/
Su.6.50.11 kampayantī śirogrīvaṃ yamalāṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet/
Su.6.50.12 kṣudrikā nāma sā hikkā jatrumūlāt pradhāvitā/
Su.6.50.15 āyamyate hikkato+aṅgāni yasya dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ tāmyate yasya gāḍham/
kṣīṇo+annadviṭ †kāsate yaśca hikkī tau dvāvantyau varjayeddhikkamānau//
yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vā mākṣikeṇāvapīḍe pippalyo vā śarkarācūrṇayuktāḥ//
Su.6.50.17 sarpiḥ koṣṇaṃ kṣīramikṣo raso vā nātikṣīṇe chardanaṃ †śāntihetoḥ/
nārīpayaḥpiṣṭamaśuklacandanaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sasaindhavaṃ tathā//
Su.6.50.18 cūrṇīkṛtaṃ saindhavamambhasā+athavā nihanti hikkāṃ ca hitaṃ ca nasyataḥ/
yuñjyāddhūmaṃ śālaniryāsajātaṃ naipālaṃ vā goviṣāṇodbhavaṃ vā//
Su.6.50.19 sarpiḥsnigdhaiścarmabālaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā hikkāsthāne svedanaṃ cāpi kāryam/
kṣaudropetaṃ gairikaṃ kāñcanāhvaṃ lihyādbhasma grāmyasattvāsthijaṃ vā//
Su.6.50.21 svarjikṣāraṃ bījapūrādrasena kṣaudropetaṃ hanti līḍhvā++āśu hikkām/
sarpiḥsnigdhā ghnanti hikkāṃ yavāgvaḥ koṣṇagrāsāḥ pāyaso vā sukhoṣṇaḥ//
Su.6.50.22 śuṇṭhītoye sādhitaṃ kṣīramājaṃ tadvat pītaṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ vā/
ātṛptervā sevyamānaṃ nihantyād ghrātaṃ hikkāmāśu mūtraṃ tvajāvyoḥ//
Su.6.50.24 pibet palaṃ vā lavaṇottamasya dvābhyāṃ palābhyāṃ haviṣaḥ samagram/
Su.6.50.26 kṛṣṇāṃ sitāṃ cāmalakaṃ ca līḍhaṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhunā+athavā+api/
Su.6.50.27 pāṭalāyāḥ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ gairikaṃ kaṭurohiṇī/
Su.6.50.28 catvāra ete yogāḥ syuḥ pratipādapradarśitāḥ/
Su.6.50.30 virecanaṃ pathyatamaṃ sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sitopalāyutam/
taireva kāraṇaiḥ śvāso ghoro bhavati dehinām//
Su.6.51.4 vihāya prakṛtiṃ vāyuḥ prāṇo+atha kaphasaṃyutaḥ/
bhidyate sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsa eko viśeṣataḥ//
Su.6.51.6 prāgrūpaṃ tasya hṛtpīḍā bhaktadveṣo+aratiḥ parā/
ānāhaḥ pārśvayoḥ śūlaṃ vairasyaṃ vadanasya ca//
niṣaṇṇasyaiti śāntiṃ ca sa kṣudra iti saṃjñitaḥ//
Su.6.51.9 ghoṣeṇa mahatā++āviṣṭaḥ sakāsaḥ sakapho naraḥ/
Su.6.51.10 sa śāmyati kaphe hīne svapataśca vidhardhate/
Su.6.51.11 ādhmāto dahyamānena bastinā sarujaṃ naraḥ/
saṃrabdhanetrastvāyamya yaḥ śvasyāt sa mahān smṛtaḥ/
Su.6.51.14 kṣudraḥ sādhyatamasteṣāṃ tamakaḥ kṛcchra ucyate/
trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti tamako durbalasya ca//
Su.6.51.15 snehabastiṃ vinā† kecidūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam/
Su.6.51.16 śvāse kāse ca hikkāyāṃ hṛdroge cāpi pūjitam/
Su.6.51.20 arśāṃsyarocakaṃ gulmaṃ śakṛdbhedaṃ kṣayaṃ tathā/
Su.6.51.23 śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ tathā hikkāṃ sarpiretanniyacchati/
suvahā kālikā bhargī śukākhyā naiculaṃ phalam//
vāsāghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ cātra hitaṃ bhavet//
Su.6.51.30 tailaṃ daśaguṇe siddhaṃ bhṛṅgarājarase śubhe/
Su.6.51.32 hanyuḥ śvāsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca saṃskṛtāni payāṃsi ca/
timirasya† ca bījāni karkaṭākhyā ca cūrṇitā//
Su.6.51.34 bhārgītvak śṛṅgaveraṃ ca śarkarā śallakāṅgajam/
Su.6.51.35 pañca ślokārdhikāstvete lehā ye samyagīritāḥ/
Su.6.51.41 sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihan hanti śvāsān sudāruṇān/
haridrāṃ maricaṃ drākṣāṃ guḍaṃ rāsnāṃ kaṇāṃ śaṭīm//
Su.6.51.43 lihyācchvāsseṣu kāseṣu vājināṃ vā śakṛdrasam/
Su.6.51.44 śvāsakāsāpahāste+api kāsaghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ/
Su.6.51.45 pippalīṃ maricaṃ caṇḍāṃ gośakṛdrasameva ca/
Su.6.51.47 surā sauvīrakaṃ hiṅgu mātuluṅgaraso madhu/
Su.6.51.49 khastho vilayanaṃ yāti mārutaśca praśāmyati/
Su.6.51.50 vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā bhiṣag dhūmaṃ prayojayet/
Su.6.51.53 ete sarve sasarpiṣkā dhūmāḥ kāryā vijānatā/
Su.6.51.54 durbale caiva rūkṣe ca tarpaṇaṃ hitamucyate/
Su.6.51.55 nidigdhikāṃ cāmalakapramāṇāṃ hiṅgvardhayuktāṃ madhunā suyuktām/
lihannaraḥ śvāsanipīḍito hi śvāsaṃ jayatyeva balāttryaheṇa//
Su.6.51.56 yathā+agniriddhaḥ †pavanānuviddho vajraṃ yathā vā surarājamuktam/
rogāstathaite khalu durnivārāḥ śvāsaśca kāsaśca vilambikā ca//
Su.6.52.3 uktā ye hetavo nṝṇāṃ rogayoḥ śvāsahikkayoḥ/
nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣaḥ kāsaḥ sa vidvadbhirudāhṛtastu//
Su.6.52.6 sa vātapittaprabhavaḥ kaphācca kṣatāttathā+anyaḥ kṣayajo+aparaśca/
pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sa pāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ//
Su.6.52.10 pralipyamānena(vilipyamānena) mukhena sīdan śirorujārtaḥ kaphapūrṇadehaḥ/
Su.6.52.11 vakṣo+atimātraṃ vihataṃ tu yasya vyāyāmabhārādhyayanābhighātaiḥ/
viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ sa naraḥ saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvatyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣatajaṃ† tamūhuḥ//
Su.6.52.12 sa gātraśūlajvaradāhamohān prāṇakṣayaṃ copalabheta kāsī/
śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam//
vṛddhatvamāsādya †bhavettu yo vai yāpyaṃ tamāhurbhiṣajastu kāsam//
uṣṇāmbunā hiṅguyutaṃ tu pītvā baddhāsyamapyāśu jahāti kāsam//
Su.6.52.16 pathyāṃ sitāmāmalakāni lājāṃ samāgadhīṃ cāpi vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīm/
sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihīta kāsī sasaindhavāṃ voṣṇajalena kṛṣṇām//
Su.6.52.17 khādedguḍaṃ nāgarapippalībhyāṃ drākṣāṃ ca sarpirmadhunā+avalihyāt/
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhukaṃ tugāṃ ca//
Su.6.52.18 lihyādghṛtakṣaudrayutāṃ samāṃśāṃ sitopalāṃ vā maricāṃśayuktām/
Su.6.52.19 hareṇukāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca †tulyāṃ dadhnā pibet kāsagadābhibhūtaḥ/
ubhe haridre suradāruśuṇṭhīṃ gāyatrisāraṃ ca pibet samāṃśam//
Su.6.52.20 bastasya mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā dantīṃ dravantīṃ ca satilvakākhyām†/
bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣyatha bādarāṇi khādet palāśāni sasaindhavāni//
Su.6.52.21 kolapramāṇaṃ prapibeddhi hiṅgu sauvīrakeṇāmlarasena vā+api/
kṣaudreṇa lihyānmaricāni vā+api bhārgīvacāhiṅgukṛtā ca vartiḥ//
Su.6.52.22 dhūme praśastā ghṛtasaṃprayuktā veṇutvagelālavaṇaiḥ kṛtā vā/
Su.6.52.23 vidhāya vartīśca payo+anupānaṃ dhūmaṃ pibedvātabalāsakāsī/
pibecca sīdhuṃ maricānvitaṃ vā tenāśu kāsaṃ jayati prasahya//
Su.6.52.25 utkārikāṃ sarpiṣi nāgarāḍhyāṃ paktvā samūlaistruṭikolapatraiḥ/
ebhirniṣeveta kṛtāṃ ca peyāṃ tanvīṃ suśītāṃ madhunā vimiśrām//
Su.6.52.26 yat plīhni sarpirvihitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tadvātakāsaṃ jayati prasahya/
vidārigandhādikṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā rasena vā vāsakajena pakvam//
Su.6.52.27 virecanaṃ snaihikamatra coktamāsthāpanaṃ cāpyanuvāsanaṃ ca/
dhūmaṃ pibet snaihikamapramattaḥ pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtameva cātra//
Su.6.52.28 hitā yavāgvaśca raseṣu siddhāḥ payāṃsi lehāḥ saghṛtāstathaiva/
Su.6.52.29 uṣṇāśca lehāḥ kaṭukā nihanyuḥ kaphaṃ viśeṣeṇa viśoṣaṇaṃ ca/
kaṭutrikaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṛmighnasvarase vipakvam//
Su.6.52.30 nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ kaphotthaṃ vinihanti kāsam/
Su.6.52.33 ghṛtaṃ pacedikṣurasāmbudugdhaiḥ kākolivarge ca saśarkaraṃ tat/
prātaḥ pibet pittakṛte ca kāse ratiprasūte kṣataje ca kāse//
kṣaudreṇa kāse kṣataje kṣayotthe pibedghṛtaṃ cekṣurase vipakvam//
Su.6.52.36 cūrṇaṃ pibedāmalakasya vā+api kṣīreṇa pakvaṃ saghṛtaṃ hitāśī/
Su.6.52.37 kāseṣu peyastriṣu kāsavadbhiḥ kṣīreṇa sakṣaudraghṛtena vā+api/
guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ pibeddhi kṣaudreṇa śītaṃ maricopadaṃśam//
dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭāvaṣṭau ca tailasya pacedyathāvat//
Su.6.52.41 śāmyanti cāyaṃ ciramantaragnerhatasya puṃstvasya ca vṛddhihetuḥ/
strīṇāṃ ca vandhyāmayanāśanaḥ syāt kalyāṇako nāma guḍaḥ pratītaḥ//
Su.6.52.43 dvipālikān †nyasya yavāḍhakaṃ ca harītakīnāṃ ca śataṃ gurūṇām/
droṇe jalasyāḍhakasaṃyute ca kvāthe kṛte pūtacaturthabhāge//
Su.6.52.44 pacettulāṃ śuddhaguḍasya dattvā pṛthak ca tailāt kuḍavaṃ ghṛtācca/
cūrṇaṃ ca tāvanmagadhodbhavāyā deyaṃ ca tasminmadhu siddhaśīte//
Su.6.52.45 rasāyanāt karṣamato vilihyāddve cābhaye nityamathāśu hanyāt/
Su.6.52.47 kulīraśuktīcaṭakaiṇalāvānniṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam/
pacedghṛtaṃ tattu niṣevyamāṇaṃ hanyāt kṣatotthaṃ kṣayajaṃ ca kāsam// śatāvarīnāgabalāvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ ca hitāya kāsinām/
srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ//
Su.6.53.4 vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanairvadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca/
Su.6.53.5 kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanairvadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ†/
Su.6.53.6 dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa cāpi(vāpi) hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ/
Su.6.53.7 kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ/
medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti//
Su.6.53.9 yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta/
vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha//
Su.6.53.11 pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ hantyanilaṃ siddhamārtagale rase/
Su.6.53.13 kṣīrānupānaṃ pitte tu pibet sarpiratandritaḥ/
Su.6.53.15 pibet kaṭūni mūtreṇa kaphaje svarasaṃkṣaye/
lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā//
dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ//
Su.6.54.7 viṃśateḥ kṛmijātīnāṃ trividhaḥ saṃbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ/
Su.6.54.9 śvetāḥ sūkṣmāstudantyete gudaṃ pratisaranti ca/
Su.6.54.16 te saraktāśca kṛṣṇāśca snigdhāśca pṛthavastathā/
jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ//
Su.6.54.23 pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ sukhāmbunā/
Su.6.54.24 snehenoktena cainaṃ tu yojayet snehabastinā/
Su.6.54.28 khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibedanu/
Su.6.54.32 pūtīkasvarasaṃ vā+api pibedvā madhunā saha/
Su.6.54.33 saptarātraṃ pibedghṛṣṭaṃ trapu vā dadhimastunā/
niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat//
Su.6.54.39 pravyaktatikatakaṭukaṃ bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ bhavet/
Su.6.54.40 kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti/
Su.6.55.3 adhaścordhvaṃ ca bhāvānāṃ pravṛttānāṃ svabhāvataḥ/
na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ//
Su.6.55.7 ādhmānaśūlau hṛdayoparodhaṃ śirorujaṃ śvāsamatīva hikkām/
Su.6.55.8 kuryādapāno+abhihataḥ svamārge hanyāt purīṣaṃ mukhataḥ kṣipedvā/
āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ//
Su.6.55.9 purīṣamāsyādapi vā nireti purīṣavege+abhihate narasya/
mūtrasya vege+abhihate narastu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute+alpamalpam//
Su.6.55.12 ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptamamuñcato hi/
śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena//
Su.6.55.14 udgāravege+abhihate bhavanti ghorā vikārāḥ pavanaprasūtāḥ/
chardervighātena bhavecca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannam//
Su.6.55.15 mūtrāśaye †pāyuni muṣkayośca śopho rujo mūtravinigrahaśca/
śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre//
Su.6.55.16 tandrāṅgamardārucivibhramāḥ †syuḥ kṣudho+abhighātāt kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ/
Su.6.55.20 sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha me/
Su.6.55.21 purīṣaje tu kartavyo vidhirānāhiko bhavet/
Su.6.55.22 elāṃ vā+apyatha madyena kṣīraṃ vā+api pibennaraḥ/
māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibedvā sīdhu gauḍikam//
Su.6.55.24 bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā/
Su.6.55.25 duḥsparśāsvarasaṃ vā+api kaṣāyaṃ kuṅkumasya ca/
Su.6.55.34 kṣudvighāte hitaṃ snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam/
Su.6.55.35 bhojyo rasena viśrāntaḥ śramaśvāsāturo naraḥ/
Su.6.55.36 ādhmānādyeṣu rogeṣu yathāsvaṃ prayateta hi/
yacca yatra bhavetprāptaṃ tacca tasmin prayojayet//
bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi//
Su.6.55.41 labhate ca bahūnanyān vikārān vātakopajān/
Su.6.55.43 athainaṃ bahuśaḥ svinnaṃ yuñjyāt snehavirecanaiḥ/
Su.6.55.47 ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet/
gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayettu gudānugāḥ/
Su.6.56.3 ajīrṇamāmaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca yadīritam/
Su.6.56.5 na tāṃ parimitāhārā labhante viditāgamāḥ/
Su.6.56.6 mūrcchātisārau vamathuḥ pipāsā śūlaṃ bhramodveṣṭanajṛmbhadāhāḥ/
vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaśca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaśca bhedaḥ//
Su.6.56.8 vātavarconirodhaśca kukṣau yasya bhṛśaṃ bhavet/
Su.6.56.9 duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvamadhaśca yasya/
Su.6.56.10 yatrasthamāmaṃ virujettameva deśaṃ viśeṣeṇa vikārajātaiḥ/
Su.6.56.12 sādhyāsu pārṣṇyordahanaṃ praśastamagnipratāpo vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam/
pakve tato+anne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt saṃpācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca//
Su.6.56.13 viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva mūrcchātisārādirupaiti śāntim/
āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogānaparānnibodha//
sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihantyajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīmaruciṃ ca sadyaḥ//
Su.6.56.15 kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viṣaṃ vā guḍapragāḍhānatha sarṣapān vā/
amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau//
Su.6.56.16 kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇairupetaṃ pibet snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu/
Su.6.56.17 kṛṣṇājamodakṣavakāṇi vā+api tulyau pibedvā magadhānikumbhau/
dantīyuta vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena//
vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpyatha mātuluṅgyāḥ//
Su.6.56.19 chāyāviśuṣkā guṭikāḥ kṛtāstā hanyurvisūcīṃ nayanāñjanena/
suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghataṃ vā manujaṃ viditvā//
āmaṃ śakṛdvā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena//
Su.6.56.22 āmāśaye śūlamatho gurutvaṃ hṛllāsa udgāravighātanaṃ ca/
Su.6.56.23 śvāsaśca pakvāśayaje bhavanti liṅgāni cātrālasakodbhavāni/
Su.6.56.24 athetaraṃ yo na śakṛdvamettamāmaṃ jayet svedanapācanaiśca/
Su.6.56.25 tānyeva vartīrviracedvicūrṇya mahiṣyajāvībhagavāṃ tu mūtraiḥ/
svinnasya pāyau viniveśya tāśca cūrṇāni caiṣāṃ pradhamettu nāḍyā//
Su.6.56.26 mūtreṣu saṃsādhya yathāvidhānaṃ dravyāṇi yānyūrdhvamadhaśca yānti/
eṣveva tailena ca sādhitena prāptaṃ yadi syādanuvāsayecca//
Su.6.57.3 doṣaiḥ pṛthak saha ca cittaviparyayācca bhaktāyaneṣu hṛdi cāvatate pragāḍham/
nānne rucirbhavati taṃ bhiṣajo vikāraṃ bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti///
Su.6.57.4 hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ virasānanatvaṃ vātātmake bhavati liṅgamarocake tu/
hṛddāhacoṣabahutā mukhatiktatā ca mūrcchā satṛḍ bhavati pittakṛte tathaiva//
sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā bahūni rūpāṇyathāsya hṛdaye samudīrayanti//
vāte vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavān pibecca snehaiḥ surābhirathavoṣṇajalena cūrṇam//
Su.6.57.8 nimbāmbuvāmitavataḥ kaphaje+anupānaṃ rājadrumāmbu madhunā tu sadīpyakaṃ syāt/
bījaiḥ karañjanṛpavṛkṣabhavaiśca piṣṭairlehaṃ pacet surabhimūtrayutaṃ yathāvat//
Su.6.57.10 mustāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca kuṣṭhamatha nirdahanīṃ ca piṣṭvā/
mūtre+avije dviradamūtrayute pacedvā pāṭhāṃ tugāmativiṣāṃ rajanīṃ ca mukhyām//
Su.6.57.11 maṇḍūkimarkamamṛtāṃ ca salāṅgalākhyāṃ mūtre pacettu mahiṣasya vidhānavidvā/
etānna santi caturo lihatastu lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayāśca//
Su.6.57.12 sātmyān †svadeśaracitān vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān pānāni mūlaphalaṣāḍavarāgayogān/
adyādrasāṃśca vividhān vividhaiḥ prakārairbhuñjīta cāpi laghurūkṣamanaḥsukhāni//
Su.6.57.13 āsthāpanaṃ vidhivadatra virecanaṃ ca kuryānmṛdūni śirasaśca virecanāni/
Su.6.57.14 kṣaudrāyutāni vitarenmukhabodhanārthamanyāni† tiktakaṭukāni ca bheṣajāni/
Su.6.57.15 mūtrāsavairguḍakṛtaiśca tathā tvariṣṭaiḥ kṣārāsavaiśca madhumādhavatulyagandhaiḥ/
syādeṣa eva kaphavātahate vidhiśca śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji praśamāya tasya//
Su.6.57.16 icchābhighātabhayaśokahate+antaragnau bhāvān bhavāya vitaret khalu śakyarūpān/
Su.6.57.17 dainyaṃ gate manasi bodhanamatra śastaṃ yadyat priyaṃ tadupasevyamarocake tu//
mūtraukasādau dvau cāpi rogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ//
vātakuṇḍalikāṃ taṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam//
vedanā ca parā bastau vātāṣṭhīleti tāṃ viduḥ//
Su.6.58.11 vegaṃ sandhārya mūtrasya yo bhūyaḥ sraṣṭumicchati/
Su.6.58.15 bastau vā+apyathavā nāle maṇau vā yasya dehinaḥ/
Su.6.58.18 abhyantare bastimukhe vṛtto+alpaḥ sthira eva ca/
bastiṃ meḍhraṃ gudaṃ caiva pradahan srāvayedadhaḥ//
Su.6.58.23 mūtraṃ hāridramathavā saraktaṃ raktameva vā/
Su.6.58.24 viśadaṃ pītakaṃ mūtraṃ sadāhaṃ bahalaṃ tathā/
Su.6.58.25 mūtraukasādaṃ taṃ vidyādrogaṃ pittakṛtaṃ budhaḥ/
Su.6.58.27 kaṣāyakalkasarpiṃṣi bhakṣyān lehān payāṃsi ca/
Su.6.58.42 tālasya taruṇaṃ mūlaṃ trapusasya rasaṃ tathā/
śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ caiva prātastu payasā pibet//
Su.6.58.43 śṛtaṃ vā madhuraiḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmiśraṃ pibennaraḥ/
Su.6.58.45 akṣabījaṃ ca surayā kalkīkṛtya pibennaraḥ/
kṣīre pariśṛtān tatra pibet sarpiḥ samāyutān//
Su.6.58.49 pibedguḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāllehān pṛthak pṛthak/
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣe kramaṃ hitam//
vidhānaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ hi vyāsataḥ parikīrtitam//
Su.6.58.53 kṣaudrārdhapātraṃ dattvā ca pātraṃ tu kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ/
śarkarāyāśca cūrṇaṃ ca drākṣācūrṇaṃ ca tatsamam//
tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ līḍhvā kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet//
Su.6.58.56 etat sarpiḥ prayuñjānaḥ śuddhadeho naraḥ sadā/
Su.6.58.57 jayecchoṇitadoṣāṃśca vandhyā garbhaṃ labheta ca/
Su.6.58.58 balā kolāsthi madhukaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrā+atha śatāvarī/
Su.6.58.60 etāni samabhāgāni matimān saha sādhayet/
Su.6.58.61 droṇāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pūtaṃ pacettena ghṛtāḍhakam/
tat siddhaṃ kalaśe sthāpyaṃ kṣaudraprasthena saṃyutam//
tasya khādedyathāśakti mātrāṃ kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet//
Su.6.58.65 ojasvī balavānmartyaḥ pibenneva ca hṛṣyati/
Su.6.58.66 drākṣā viśālā pippalyastathā citraphalā bhevet/
Su.6.58.69 tato mitaṃ pibetkāle yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam/
Su.6.58.71 †prakṣāhitaṃ ca dhanyaṃ ca sarvarogāpahaṃ śivam/
Su.6.59.3 vātena pittena kaphena sarvaistathā+ābhighātaiḥ śakṛdaśmarībhyām/
Su.6.59.9 vātabastestu tulyāni tasya liṅgāni lakṣayet/
Su.6.59.10 ādhmānaṃ ca saśūlaṃ ca mūtrasaṅgaṃ karoti hi/
śarkarāyā viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇu kīrtayato mama//
Su.6.59.13 hṛtpīḍā vepathuḥ śūlaṃ kukṣau† vahniḥ sudurbalaḥ/
Su.6.59.16 aśmarīṃ ca samāśritya yaduktaṃ prasamīkṣya tat/
Su.6.59.18 tathā vidārigandhādiṃ saṃhṛtya traivṛtaṃ pacet/
tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tat peyaṃ tena vā+apyanuvāsanam//
Su.6.59.21 pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittakṛcchraṃ nāśayet kṣīrameva vā/
Su.6.59.26 mūtrakṛcchre śakṛjjāte kāryā vātaharī kriyā/
Su.6.59.27 ye tvanye tu tathā kṛcchre tayoḥ proktaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ//
Su.6.60.5 aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ vā yadi vā+akṣatam/
Su.6.60.7 devāstathā śatrugaṇāśca teṣāṃ gandharvayakṣāḥ pitaro bhujaṅgāḥ/
rakṣāṃsi yā cāpi piśācajātireṣo+aṣṭako devagaṇo grahākhyaḥ//
Su.6.60.8 saṃtuṣṭaḥ śucirapi ceṣṭagandhamālyo nistandrī hyavitathasaṃskṛtaprabhāṣī/
tejasvī sthiranayano varapradātā brahmaṇyo bhavati naraḥ sa devajuṣṭaḥ//
Su.6.60.9 saṃsvedī dvijagurudevadoṣavaktā jihmākṣo vigatabhayo vimārgadṛṣṭiḥ/
santuṣṭo bhavati na cānnapānajātairduṣṭātmā bhavati ca devaśatrujuṣṭaḥ//
nṛtyan vai prahasati cāru cālpaśabdaṃ gandharvagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ//
tejasvī vadati ca kiṃ dadāmi kasmai yo yakṣagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ//
Su.6.60.12 pretebhyo visṛjati saṃstareṣu piṇḍān śāntātmā jalamapi cāpasavyavastraḥ/
Su.6.60.13 bhūmau yaḥ prasarati sarpavat kadācit sṛkkiṇyau vilikhati† jihvayā tathaiva/
krodhālurvipulabalo niśāvihārī śaucadviḍ bhavati ca rakṣasā gṛhītaḥ//
Su.6.60.16 sthūlākṣastvaritagatiḥ svaphenalehī nidrāluḥ patati ca kampate ca yo+ati/
yaścādridviradanagādivicyutaḥ san saṃsṛṣṭo na bhavati vārdhakena juṣṭaḥ//
Su.6.60.18 kṛṣṇakṣaye ca pitaraḥ paścamyāmapi coragāḥ/
Su.6.60.19 darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino yathā/
svamaṇiṃ bhāskarasyosrā yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk/
Su.6.60.20 tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi tathaiva dānaṃ vratāni dharmo niyamāśca satyam/
guṇāstathā+aṣṭāvapi teṣu nityā vyastāḥ samastāśca yathāprabhāvam//
Su.6.60.21 na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na vā manuṣyān kvacidāviśanti/
Su.6.60.22 teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ paricārakā ye koṭīsahasrāyutapadmasaṃkhyāḥ/
Su.6.60.23 niśācarāṇāṃ teṣāṃ hi ye devagaṇamāśritāḥ/
Su.6.60.24 devagrahā iti punaḥ procyante+aśucayaśca† ye/
Su.6.60.27 bhūtānīti kṛtā saṃjñā teṣāṃ saṃjñāpravaktṛbhiḥ/
Su.6.60.30 bhakṣyāśca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhirucyate/
Su.6.60.31 yāni yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭāni tāni tebhyaḥ pradāpayet/
hiṃsanti manujān yeṣu prāyaśo divaseṣu tu//
Su.6.60.38 na śakyā balibhirjetuṃ yogaistān samupācaret/
Su.6.60.39 hiṅguṃ mūtraṃ ca bastasya dhūmamasya prayojayet/
etena śāmyati kṣipraṃ balavānapi yo grahaḥ//
Su.6.60.43 śirīṣabījaṃ laśunaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ siddhārthakaṃ vacām/
Su.6.60.45 haridre ca kṛtā vartyaḥ pūrvavannayanāñjanam/
saindhavaṃ kaṭukāṃ hiṅguṃ vayaḥsthāṃ ca vacāmapi/
Su.6.60.46 ye ye grahā na sidhyanti sarveṣāṃ nayanāñjanam/
Su.6.60.47 golomī cājalomī ca bhūtakeśī jaṭā tathā/
Su.6.60.48 vajraproktā† vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavallikā/
Su.6.60.49 naipālī haritālaṃ ca rakṣoghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ/
Su.6.60.51 asmin varge bhiṣak kuryāttailāni ca ghṛtāni ca/
Su.6.60.55 ṛte piśācādanyatra pratikūlaṃ na cācaret/
tataḥ prāpsyati siddhiṃ ca yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhiṣak//
Su.6.61.7 hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā svedo dhyānaṃ mūrcchā pramūḍhatā/
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ vivṛtākṣaḥ patet kṣitau//
Su.6.61.10 alpakālānataraṃ cāpi punaḥ saṃjñāṃ labheta saḥ/
so+apasmāra iti proktaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭaścaturvidhaḥ//
vepamāno daśan dantān śvasan phenaṃ vamannapi//
Su.6.61.12 yo brūyādvikṛtaṃ sattvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māmanudhāvati/
Su.6.61.14 tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt sa pittabhava ucyate/
Su.6.61.15 yo brūyādvikṛtaṃ sattvaṃ śuklaṃ māmanudhāvati/
tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt so+apasmāraḥ kaphātmakaḥ//
pralāpaḥ kūjanaṃ kleśaḥ pratyekaṃ tu bhavediha//
Su.6.61.19 āgamādvaiśvarūpyācca sa tu nirvarṇyate budhaiḥ/
deve varṣatyapi yathā bhūmau bījāni kānicit//
Su.6.61.22 tasya kāryo vidhiḥ sarvo ya unmādeṣu vakṣyate/
Su.6.61.23 upayogo grahoktānāṃ yogānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ/
tataḥ sidhyanti te sarve yogairanyaiśca sādhayet/
Su.6.61.24 caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre tailābhyañjane hitam/
Su.6.61.25 pitteṣu siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pānābhyaṅgeṣu pūjitam/
Su.6.61.26 pūjāṃ rudrasya kurvīta tadgaṇānāṃ ca nityaśaḥ/
Su.6.61.28 jaṭilāṃ pañcamūlyau dve pathyāṃ cotkvāthya yatnataḥ/
Su.6.61.29 kākolyādipratīvāpaṃ siddhaṃ ca prathame gaṇe/
Su.6.61.30 kākolyādipratīvāpaṃ siddhaṃ ca prathame gaṇe/
Su.6.61.39 jñātvā ca madhurībhūtaṃ taṃ viśasyānnamuddharet/
śuddhe kumbhe nidadhyācca saṃbhāraṃ taṃ surāṃ tataḥ//
sirāṃ vidhyedatha prāptāṃ maṅgalyāni ca dhārayet//
mānasena ca duḥkhena sa pañcavidha ucyate//
Su.6.62.5 viṣādbhavati ṣaṣṭhaśca yathāsvaṃ tatra bheṣajam/
Su.6.62.8 rūkṣacchaviḥ paruṣavāgdhamanītato vā †śītāturaḥ kṛśatanuḥ sphuritāṅgasandhiḥ/
āsphoṭayasyaṭati gāyati nṛtyaśīlo vikrośati bhramati cāpyanilaprakopāt//
tīkṣṇo himāmbuni caye+api sa vahniśaṅkī pittāddivā nabhasi paśyati tārakāśca//
nidrāparo+alpakathano+alpabhuguṣṇasevī rātrau bhṛśaṃ bhavati cāpi kaphaprakopāt//
Su.6.62.11 sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā yathāsvaṃ saṃharṣitā iva ca liṅgamudīrayanti//
gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā riraṃsorjāyeta cotkaṭataro manaso vikāraḥ//
Su.6.62.13 citraṃ sa jalpati manonugataṃ visaṃjño gāyatyatho hasati roditi †mūḍhasaṃjñaḥ/
raktekṣaṇo hatabalendriyabhāḥ sudīnaḥ śyāvānano viṣakṛto†+atha bhavet parāsuḥ//
Su.6.62.14 snigdhaṃ svinnaṃ tu manujamunmādārtaṃ viśodhayet/
sarṣapānāṃ ca tailena nasyābhyaṅgau hitau sadā//
Su.6.62.18 bhīṣayet saṃyataṃ pāśaiḥ kaśābhirvā+atha tāḍayet/
Su.6.62.21 kevalānambuyuktān vā kulmāṣān vā bahuśrutaḥ/
hṛdyaṃ yaddīpanīyaṃ ca tatpathyaṃ tasya bhojayet(yojayet)//
Su.6.62.26 apasmāraṃ grahaṃ śoṣaṃ klaibyaṃ kārśyamabījatām/
khyātaṃ phalaghṛtaṃ strīṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ cāśu garbhadam//)
Su.6.62.30 brahmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu surāṃ jaṭhām/
viṣaghnīṃ laśunaṃ rāsnāṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām//
viṣaje mṛdupūrvāṃ ca viṣaghnīṃ kārayet kriyām//
Su.6.63.4 avidagdhā vidagdhāśca bhidyante te triṣaṣṭidhā/
Su.6.63.7 trīṃścānugacchati raso lavaṇaḥ kaṭuko dvayam/
tiktaḥ kaṣāyamanveti te dvikā daśa pañca ca//

Su.6.63.8 tadyathā madhurāmlaḥ, madhuralavaṇaḥ, madhurakaṭukaḥ, madhuratiktaḥ, madhurakaṣāyaḥ, ete pañcānukrāntā madhureṇa; amlalavaṇaḥ, amlakaṭukaḥ, amlatiktaḥ, amlakaṣāyaḥ, ete catvāro+anukrāntā amlena; lavaṇakaṭukaḥ, lavaṇatiktaḥ, lavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, ete trayo+anukāntā lavaṇena; kaṭutiktaḥ, kaṭukaṣāyaḥ, dvāvetāvanukrāntau kaṭukena; tiktakaṣāyaḥ eka evānukrāntastiktena; †evamete pañcadaśa dvikasaṃyogā vyākhyātāḥ//
Su.6.63.9 trikān vakṣyāmaḥ ādau prayujyamānastu madhuro daśa gacchati/

Su.6.63.10 tadyathā madhurāmlalavaṇaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭukaḥ, madhurāmlatiktaḥ, madhurāmalakaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭukaḥ, madhuralavaṇātiktaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, madhurakaṭukatiktaḥ, madhurakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhuratiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ daśānāṃ trikasaṃyogānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ, amlalavaṇatiktaḥ, amlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, amlakaṭutiktaḥ, amlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, amlatiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāmādāvamlaḥ prayujyate; lavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ, lavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, lavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ trayāṇāmādau lavaṇaḥ prayujyate; kaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evamekasyādau kaṭukaḥ prayujyate; evamete trikasaṃyogā viṃśatirvyākhyātāḥ//

Su.6.63.12 madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇatiktaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭukatiktaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlatiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭukatiktaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhurakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ daśānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ, amlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, amlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, amlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ caturṇāmādāvamlaḥ; lavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evamekasyādau lavaṇaḥ; evamete catuṣkarasasaṃyogāḥ pañcadaśa kīrtitāḥ//

Su.6.63.14 madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ pañcānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evamekasyādāvamlaḥ; evamete ṣaṭ pañcakasaṃyogā vyākhyātāḥ//
Su.6.63.15 ṣaṭkamekaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ; ekastu ṣaṭkasaṃyogaḥ madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ; eṣa eka eva ṣaṭsaṃyogaḥ//
Su.6.63.16 ekaikaśca ṣaṭsā bhavanti madhuraḥ, amlaḥ, lavaṇaḥ, kaṭukaḥ, tiktaḥ, kaṣāyaḥ, iti//
Su.6.64.3 sūtrasthāne samuddiṣṭaḥ svastho bhavati yādṛśaḥ/
Su.6.64.4 tasya yadvṛttamuktaṃ hi rakṣaṇaṃ ca mayā++āditaḥ/
Su.6.64.5 yasmin yasminnṛtau ye ye doṣāḥ kupyanti dehinām/
teṣu teṣu pradātavyāḥ rasāste te vijānatā//
Su.6.64.12 śīte sāgnau nivāte ca guruprāvaraṇe gṛhe/
Su.6.64.15 salilaṃ ca prasannatvāt sarvameva tadā hitam/
Su.6.64.18 rātrau jāgagṇaṃ caiva maithunaṃ cāpi varjayet/
bhajecca śāradaṃ mālyaṃ sīdhoḥ pānaṃ ca yuktitaḥ//
Su.6.64.21 pittapraśamanaṃ yacca tacca sarvaṃ samācaret/
Su.6.64.23 rasamucchoṣayatyāśu tasmāt snigdhaṃ tadā hitam/
Su.6.64.27 prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ tarpito nṛpaḥ/
Su.6.64.28 annapānaṃ tilān māṣāñchākāni ca dadhīni ca/
Su.6.64.30 madyāni ca prasannāni yacca kiñcit balapradam/
) eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire samudāhṛtaḥ//
auṣṇyādvasante kupitaḥ kurute ca gadān bahūn//
Su.6.64.36 vyāyāmamañjanaṃ dhūmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca kavalagraham/
utsādanaṃ tathā snānaṃ vanitāḥ kānanāni ca//
Su.6.64.43 gharmakāle niṣeveta vāsāṃsi sulaghūni ca/
Su.6.64.44 pānakāni ca seveta manthāṃścāpi saśarkarān/
bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ śītaṃ saghṛtaṃ madhuradravam//
Su.6.64.45 śṛtena payasā rātrau śarkarāmadhureṇa ca/
tāpātyaye hitā nityaṃ rasā ye guravastrayaḥ//
Su.6.64.47 payo māṃsarasāḥ koṣṇāstailāni ca ghṛtāni ca/
vyāyāmaṃ ca divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātra varjayet//
Su.6.64.51 harmyamadhye nivāte ca bhajecchayyāṃ mṛdūttarām/
Su.6.64.53 taddhi srvopayogeṣu tasmin kāle vivarjayet/
Su.6.64.54 pibet prāvṛṣi jīrṇāṃstu rātrau tānapi varjayet/
ṛtāvṛtau ya etena vidhinā vartate naraḥ//
Su.6.64.61 śuṣkadehān pipāsārtān durbalānapi ca dravaiḥ/
ataḥ paraṃ tu svasthānāṃ vṛttyarthaṃ sarva eva ca/
†tatrābhaktaṃ prāgbhaktamadhobhaktaṃ madhyebhaktamantarābhaktaṃ sabhaktaṃ sāmudgaṃ muhurmuhurgrāsaṃ grāsāntaraṃ ceti daśauṣadhakālāḥ//
Su.6.64.67 vīryādhikaṃ bhavati bheṣajamannahīnaṃ hanyāttathā†++āmayamasaṃśayamāśu caiva/
†tadbālavṛddhavanitāmṛdavastu pītvā glāniṃ parāṃ samupayānti balakṣayaṃ ca//
Su.6.64.69 śīghraṃ vipākamupayāti balaṃ na hiṃsyādannāvṛtaṃ na ca muhurvardanānnireti/
Su.6.64.71 madhyebhaktaṃ nāma yanmadhye bhaktasya pīyate//
Su.6.64.72 pītaṃ yadannamupayujya tadūrdhvakāye hanyādgadān bahuvidhāṃśca balaṃ dadāti/
madhye tu pītamapahantyavisāribhāvādye madhyadehamabhibhūya bhavanti rogāḥ//
Su.6.64.75 pathyaṃ sabhaktamabalābalayorhi nityaṃ taddveṣiṇāmapi tathā śiśuvṛddhayośca/
hṛdyaṃ manobalakaraṃ tvatha dīpanaṃ ca pathyaṃ sadā bhavati cāntarabhaktakaṃ yat//
Su.6.64.77 doṣe dvidhā pravisṛte tu samudgasaṃjñamādyantayoryadaśanasya niṣevyate tu//
Su.6.64.79 śvāse muhurmuhuratiprasṛte ca kāse hikkāvamīṣu sa vadantyupayojyametat//
Su.6.64.82 grāseṣu† cūrṇamabalāgniṣu dīpanīyaṃ vājīkarāṇyapi tu yojayituṃ yateta/
Su.6.64.84 visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau/
viśuddhe codgāre hṛdi suvimale vāte ca sarati/
pradeyastvāhāro bhavati bhiṣajāṃ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ//

tadyathā adhikaraṇaṃ, yogaḥ, padārthaḥ, hetvarthaḥ, uddeśaḥ, nirdeśaḥ, upadeśaḥ, apadeśaḥ, pradeśaḥ, atideśaḥ, apavarjaḥ, vākyaśeṣaḥ, arthāpattiḥ, viparyayaḥ, prasaṅgaḥ, ekāntaḥ, anekāntaḥ, pūrvapakṣaḥ, nirṇayaḥ, anumataṃ, vidhānam, anāgatāvekṣaṇam, atikrāntāvekṣaṇaṃ, saṃśayaḥ, vyākhyānaṃ, svasaṃjñā, nirvacanaṃ, nidarśanaṃ, niyogaḥ, vikalpaḥ, samuccayaḥ, ūhyam, iti//
Su.6.65.4 atrāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam ucyate vākyayojanamarthayojanaṃ ca//
Su.6.65.5 bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ asadvādiprayuktānāṃ vākyānāṃ pratiṣedhanam/
Su.6.65.6 †vyāktā noktāstu ye hyarthā līnā ye cāpyanirmalāḥ/
leśoktā ye ca† kecitsyusteṣāṃ cāpi prasādhanam//
Su.6.65.8 tatra yamarthamadhikṛtyocyate tadadhikaraṇaṃ; yathā rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā//
Su.6.65.9 yena vākyaṃ yujyate sa yogaḥ/
siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge/
ityatra tailaṃ siddhaṃ pibediti prathamaṃ vaktavye tṛtīyapāde siddhamiti prayuktaṃ, evaṃ dūrasthānāmapi padānāmekīkaraṇaṃ yogaḥ//
Su.6.65.10 yo+artho+abhihitaḥ sūtre pade †vā sa padārthaḥ; padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vā+arthaḥ padārthaḥ; aparimitāśca padārthāḥ/

yathā snehasvedāñjaneṣu nirdiṣṭeṣu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā+arthānāmupapattirdṛśyate, tatra yo+arthaḥ pūrvāparayogasiddho bhavati sa grahītavyaḥ; yathā devotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityukte sandihyate buddhiḥ katamasya †vedasyotpattiṃ vakṣyatīti, yataḥ ṛgvedādayastu vedāḥ; vida vicāraṇe, vidḷ lābhe, ityetayośca dhātvoranekārthayoḥ prayogāt,tatra pūrvāparayogamupalabhya pratipattirbhavati āyurvedotpattimayaṃ vivakṣuriti; eṣa padārthaḥ//
yathā mṛtpiṇḍo+adbhiḥ praklidyate tathā māṣadugdhaprabhṛtibhirvraṇaḥ praklidyata iti//
yathā tathā na jāgṛyādrātrau divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet iti//
Su.6.65.15 anena kāraṇenetyapadeśaḥ, yathā+apadiśyate madhuraḥ śleṣmāṇamabhivardhayatīti//
Su.6.65.19 yena padenānuktena vākyaṃ samāpyeta sa vākyaśeṣaḥ/
yathā śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarorasāmityukte puruṣagrahaṇaṃ vinā+api gamyate puruṣasyeti//
yathā odanaṃ bhokṣye ityukte+arthādāpannaṃ bhavati nāyaṃ pipāsuryavāgūmiti//
yathā kṛśālpaprāṇabhīravo duścikitsyā ityukte viparītaṃ gṛhyate dṛḍhādayaḥ sucikitsyā iti//
Su.6.65.22 prakaraṇāntareṇa †samāpanaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, yadvā prakaraṇāntarito yo+artho+†asakṛduktaḥ samāpyate sa prasaṅgaḥ/

yathā pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣastasmin kriyā so+adhiṣṭhānamiti vedotpattāvabhidhāya, bhūtacintāyāṃ punaruktaṃ yato+abhihitaṃ pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa iti, sa khalveṣa karmapuruṣaścikitsādhikṛta iti//
yathā kecidācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kecidrasaṃ, kecidvīryaṃ kecidvipākamiti//
yathā kathaṃ vātanimittāścatvāraḥ pramehā asādhyā bhavantīti//
yathā śarīraṃ prapīḍya paścādadho gatvā vasāmedomajjānuviddhaṃ mūtraṃ visṛjati vātaḥ, evamasādhyā vātajā iti//
Su.6.65.27 tathā coktam kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjāvasāyutaḥ/
yathā anyo brūyāt sapta rasā iti, taccāpratiṣedhādanumanyate kathaṃciditi//
yathā iha pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puruṣo vyākhyāyate, anyeṣvāyurvedatantreṣu bhūtādiprabhṛtyārabhya †cintā//
yathā agnirvāyunā sahitaḥ †kakṣe vṛddhiṃ gacchati tathā vātapittakaphaduṣṭo vraṇa iti//

yathā abhihitamannapānavidhau caturvidhaṃ cānnamupadiśyate bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyaṃ peyamiti, evaṃ caturvidhe vaktavye dvividhamabhihitam; idamatrohyam annapāne viśiṣṭayordvayorgrahaṇe kṛte caturṇāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti; †caturvidhaścāhāraḥ praviralaḥ, prāyeṇa dvividha eva; ato dvitvaṃ prasiddhamiti/
kiñcānyat annena bhakṣyamavaruddhaṃ, ghanasādharmyāt; peyena lehyaṃ, dravasādhamyāt†//
Su.6.65.43 yo hyetā vidhivadvetti dīpībhūtāstu buddhimān/
Su.6.66.5 kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vā+apyathavā triśaḥ/
trayo doṣā dhātavaśca purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca//
Su.6.66.8 rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ca/
Su.6.66.9 vyāsataḥ kīrtitaṃ taddhi bhinnā doṣāstrayo guṇāḥ/
Su.6.66.10 traya eva pṛthak doṣā dviśo nava samādhikaiḥ/
Su.6.66.11 pañcāśadevaṃ tu saha bhavanti kṣayamāgataiḥ/
Su.6.66.14 bhiṣak kartā+atha karaṇaṃ rasā doṣāstu kāraṇam/
Su.6.66.17 sahottaraṃ tvetadadhītya sarvaṃ brāhmaṃ vidhānena yathoditena/

lines: sve sve dravye tu sarveṣāṁ vyaktaṁ lakṣaṇamiṣyate//
na śakyaścakṣuṣā draṣṭuṁ dehe sūkṣmatamo vibhuḥ/
Su.3.8.20 bhavanti cātra / sirāsu śikṣito nāsti calā hyetāḥ svabhāvataḥ// matsyavat parivartante tasmādyatnena tāḍayet//
Su.3.8.21 ajānatā gṛhīte tu śastre kāyanipātite// bhavanti vyāpadaścaitā bahavaścāpyupadravāḥ//
Su.3.8.22 snehādibhiḥ kriyāyogairna tathā lepanairapi// yāntyāśu vyādhayaḥ śāntiṁ yathā samyak sirāvyadhāt//
Su.3.8.23 sirāvyadhaścikitsārdhaṁ śalyatantre prakīrtitaḥ// yathā praṇihitaḥ samyagbastiḥ kāyacikitsate//
Su.3.8.25 bhavataścātra/ sirāviṣāṇatumbaistu jalaukābhiḥ padaistathā// avagāḍhaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ nirharedduṣṭaśoṇitam//
Su.3.8.26 avagāḍhe jalaukāḥ syāt pracchānaṁ piṇḍite hitam// sirā+aṅgavyāpake rakte śṛṅgālābū tvaci sthite//
Su.5.1.4 ripavo vikramākrāntā ye ca sve kṛtyatāṃ gatāḥ/
Su.5.1.8 kulīnaṃ dhārmikaṃ snigdhaṃ subhṛtaṃ saṃtatotthitam/
na dadātyuttaraṃ pṛṣṭo vivakṣan mohameti ca//
Su.5.1.20 apārthaṃ bahu saṅkīrṇaṃ bhāṣate cāpi mūḍhavat/
Su.5.1.23 vartate viparītaṃ tu viṣadātā vicetanaḥ/
Su.5.1.24 asatāmapi santo+api ceṣṭāṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ/
Su.5.1.26 srukṣu vastreṣu śayyāsu kavacābharaṇeṣu ca/
Su.5.1.28 nṛpabhaktādbaliṃ nyastaṃ saviṣaṃ bhakṣayanti ye/
Su.5.1.29 hutabhuk tena cānnena bhṛśaṃ caṭacaṭāyate/
Su.5.1.33 pṛṣato visṛjatyaśruṃ viṣṭhāṃ muñcati markaṭaḥ/
Su.5.1.34 veśmano+atha vibhūṣārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ cātmanaḥ sadā/
Su.5.1.35 hṛtpīḍā bhrāntanetratvaṃ śiroduḥkhaṃ ca jāyate/
tatra nasyāñjane kuṣṭhaṃ lāmajjaṃ naladaṃ madhu//
Su.5.1.37 pāṇiprāptaṃ pāṇidāhaṃ nakhaśātaṃ karoti ca/
Su.5.1.39 tudyate dahyate cāpi śleṣmā cāsyāt prasicyate/
āṭopaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ kārśyaṃ kuryāt pakvāśayaṃ gatam//
Su.5.1.45 chāyāścātra na dṛśyante dṛśyante yadi vā punaḥ/
Su.5.1.47 gandhavarṇarasairhīnāḥ sarve bhakṣyāḥ phalāni ca/
Su.5.1.54 somavallyamṛtā śvetā padmaṃ kālīyakaṃ tvacam/
Su.5.1.58 gomayasvaraso vā+api hito vā mālatīrasaḥ/
Su.5.1.61 tatra kṣaudraghṛtaṃ pānaṃ pralepaścandanaṃ ghṛtam/
Su.5.1.65 pāne nasye ca saśvetaṃ hitaṃ samadayantikam/
Su.5.1.66 jighrataśca śiroduḥkhaṃ vāripūrṇe ca locane/
tatra bāṣperitaṃ karma mukhālepe ca yat smṛtam//
Su.5.1.70 tatra sadyo ghṛtaṃ peyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca samāgadham/
śophaḥ srāvastathā svāpaḥ pādayoḥ sphoṭajanma ca//
Su.5.1.74 bhūṣaṇāni hatārcīṃṣi na vibhānti yathā purā/
Su.5.1.78 sirāśca vyadhayet kṣipraṃ prāptaṃ visrāvaṇaṃ yadi/
mūsikā+ajaruhā vā+api haste baddhā tu bhūpateḥ//
sarpirdadhi payaḥ kṣaudraṃ pibedvā śītalaṃ jalam//
dadyāt supiṣṭāṃ pālindīṃ madhukaṃ śarkarāṃ tathā//
pārṣate cāpi deyāḥ syuḥ pippalyaḥ samahauṣadhāḥ//
Su.5.1.84 sakṣaudraḥ saghṛtaścaiva śimbīyūṣo hitaḥ sadā/
Su.5.2.4 mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca/
Su.5.2.6 catvāri vatsanābhāni mustake dve prakīrtite
Su.5.2.7 udveṣṭanaṃ mūlaviṣaiḥ pralāpo moha eva ca/
kandajāni tu tīkṣṇāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram//
Su.5.2.12 sparśājñānaṃ kālakūṭe vepathuḥ stambha eva ca/
Su.5.2.15 gātrastambho vepathuśca jāyate mustakena tu/
Su.5.2.17 cireṇocchvasiti śyāvo naro hālāhalena vai/
Su.5.2.20 vikāśi viśadaṃ caiva laghvapāki ca tat smṛtam/
Su.5.2.21 matiṃ ca mohayettaikṣṇyānmarmabandhān chinatti ca/
Su.5.2.22 āśutvādāśu taddhanti vyavāyāt prakṛtiṃ bhajet/
Su.5.2.24 sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ yacca kṛtrimaṃ cāpi yadviṣam/
Su.5.2.25 yat sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamakṛtrimaṃ vā dehādaśeṣaṃ yadanirgataṃ tat/
Su.5.2.26 svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnaṃ viṣaṃ hi dūṣīviṣatāmupaiti/
Su.5.2.29 sthitaṃ rasādiṣvathavā yathoktān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān/
kopaṃ ca śītāniladurdineṣu yātyāśu pūrvaṃ śṛṇu tatra rūpam//
Su.5.2.30 nidrā gurutvaṃ ca vijṛmbhaṇaṃ ca viśleṣaharṣāvathavā+aṅgamardaḥ/
vaivarṇyamūrcchāviṣamajvarān vā kuryāt pravṛddhāṃ prabalāṃ tṛṣāṃ vā//
Su.5.2.34 sthāvarasyopayuktasya vege tu prathame nṛṇām/
śyāvā jihvā bhavetstabdhā mūrcchā śvāsaśca jāyate//
Su.5.2.35 dvitīye vepathuḥ sādo dāhaḥ kaṇṭharujastathā/
Su.5.2.36 tāluśoṣaṃ tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam/
durvarṇe harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane//
Su.5.2.40 prathame viṣavege tu vānte śītāmbusecitam/
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ kṣipet//
Su.5.2.44 vegāntare tvanyatame kṛte karmaṇi śītalām/
Su.5.2.46 punarnave hareṇuśca trikaṭuḥ sārive balā/
Su.5.2.47 madhukaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bhadradāru hareṇavaḥ/
Su.5.2.48 viḍaṅgaṃ candanaṃ patraṃ priyaṅgurdhyāmakaṃ tathā/
haridre dve bṛhatyau ca sārive ca sthirā sahā//
Su.5.2.51 pippalyo dhyāmakaṃ māṃsī śāvaraḥ paripelavam/
Su.5.2.53 jvare dāhe ca hikkāyāmānāhe śukrasaṃkṣaya/
Su.5.2.54 unmāde vepathau caiva ye cānye syurupadravāḥ/
Su.5.3.6 bhavanti cātra rājño+arideśe ripavastṛṇāmbumārgānnadhūmaśvasanān viṣeṇa/
Su.5.3.7 duṣṭaṃ jalaṃ picchilamugragandhi phenānvitaṃ rājibhirāvṛtaṃ ca/
maṇḍūkamatsyaṃ mriyate vihaṅgā mattāśca sānūpacarā bhramanti//
Su.5.3.8 majjanti ye cātra narāśvanāgāste chardimohajvaradāhaśophān/
ṛcchanti(gacchanti) teṣāmapahṛtya †doṣān duṣṭaṃ jalaṃ śodhayituṃ yateta//
Su.5.3.10 bhasmāñjaliṃ cāpi ghaṭe nidhāya viśodhayedīpsitamevamambhaḥ/
Su.5.3.11 spṛśanti gātreṇa tu yena yena govājināgoṣṭrakharā narā vā/
tacchūnatāṃ yāstyatha dahyate ca viśīryate romanakhaṃ tathaiva//
Su.5.3.12 tatrāpyanantāṃ saha sarvagandhaiḥ piṣṭvā surābhirviniyojya mārgam/
Su.5.3.13 tṛṇeṣu bhakteṣu ca dūṣiteṣu sīdanti mūrcchanti vamanti cānye/
tāraḥ sutāraḥ sasurendragopaḥ sarvaiśca tulyaḥ kuruvindabhāgaḥ//
Su.5.3.15 pittena yuktaḥ kapilānvayena vādyapralepo vihitaḥ praśastaḥ/
vādyasya śabdena hi yānti nāśaṃ viṣāṇi ghorāṇyapi yāni †santi//
Su.5.3.16 dhūme+anile vā viṣasaṃprayukte khagāḥ śramārtāḥ prapatanti bhūmau/
priyaṅgukāṃ cāpyanale nidhāya dhūmānilau cāpi viśodhayeta//
Su.5.3.19 tasya kruddhasya vai vaktrādbrahmaṇastejaso nidheḥ/
Su.5.3.20 sa taṃ dadāha garjantamantakābhaṃ mahābalam/
Su.5.3.21 tato viṣādo devānāmabhavattaṃ nirīkṣya vai/
Su.5.3.22 tataḥ sṛṣṭvā prajāḥ śeṣaṃ tadā taṃ krodhamīśvaraḥ/
vinyastavān sa bhūtesu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca//
teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu rasaṃ taṃ taṃ niyacchati//
Su.5.3.25 viṣe yasmādguṇāḥ sarve tīkṣṇāḥ prāyeṇa santi hi/
Su.5.3.26 te tu vṛttiṃ prakupitā jahati svāṃ viṣārditāḥ/
nopayati viṣaṃ pākamataḥ prāṇān ruṇaddhi ca//
anudvṛttā viṣaṃ tasmānna muñcanti ca bhoginaḥ//
Su.5.3.30 yasmādatyarthamuṣṇaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ viṣam/
Su.5.3.31 mandaṃ kīṭeṣu nātyuṣṇaṃ bahuvātakaphaṃ viṣam/
ataḥ kīṭaviṣe cāpi svedo na pratiṣidhyate//
Su.5.3.34 yathāviṣaṃ sa rogeṇa kliśyate mriyate+api vā/
Su.5.3.37 na cāsya hṛdayaṃ vahnirviṣajuṣṭaṃ dahatyapi/
yāmye sapitrye parivarjanīyā ṛkṣe narā marmasu ye ca daṣṭāḥ//
Su.5.3.39 darvīkarāṇāṃ viṣamāśughāti sarvāṇi coṣṇe dviguṇībhavanti/
śastrakṣate yasya na raktameti rājyo latābhiśca na saṃbhavanti//
Su.5.3.41 śītābhiradbhiśca na romaharṣo viṣābhibhūtaṃ parivarjayettam/
jihvā sitā yasya ca keśaśāto nāsāvabhaṅgaśca sakaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ//
Su.5.3.42 kṛṣṇaḥ saraktaḥ śvayathuśca daṃśe hanvoḥ sthiratvaṃ ca sa varjanīyaḥ/
vartirghanā yasya nireti vaktrādraktaṃ sravedūrdhvamadhaśca yasya//
Su.5.3.43 daṃṣṭrānipātāḥ sakalāśca yasya taṃ cāpi vaidyaḥ parivarjayettu/
Su.5.3.44 sāriṣṭamatyarthamaveginaṃ ca jahyānnaraṃ tatra na karma kuryāt//
Su.5.4.4 sarpasaṃkhyāṃ vibhāgaṃ ca daṣṭalakṣaṇameva ca/
Su.5.4.5 tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prābravīdbhiṣajāṃ varaḥ/
ye cāpyajasraṃ garjanti varṣanti ca tapanti ca//
Su.5.4.8 namastebhyo+asti no teṣāṃ kāryaṃ kiñciccikitsayā/
ye tu daṃṣṭrāviṣā bhaumā ye daśanti ca mānuṣān//
aśītistveva sarpāṇāṃ bhidyate pañcadhā tu sā//
teṣu darvīkarā jñeyā viṃśatiḥ ṣaṭ ca pannagāḥ//
pādābhimṛṣṭā duṣṭā vā kruddhā grāsārthino+api vā//
Su.5.4.15 padāni yatra dantānāmekaṃ dve vā bahūni vā/
Su.5.4.17 rājyaḥ salohitā yatra nīlāḥ pītāḥ sitāstathā/
kasyacit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat//
viṣaghnauṣadhiyukte ca deśe na kramate viṣam//
citritā iva ye bhānti rājimantastu te smṛtāḥ//
Su.5.4.25 muktārūpyaprabhā ye ca kapilā ye ca pannagāḥ/
Su.5.4.27 kṛṣṇā †vajranibhā ye ca lohitā varṇatastathā/
Su.5.4.29 kopayantyanilaṃ jantoḥ phaṇinaḥ sarva eva tu/
Su.5.4.31 rajanyāḥ paścime yāme sarpāścitrāścaranti hi/
Su.5.4.40 bhavanti cātra dhātvantareṣu yāḥ sapta kalāḥ saṃparikīrtitāḥ/
Su.5.4.41 yenāntareṇa tu kalāṃ kālakalpaṃ bhinatti hi/
Su.5.4.42 śūnāṅgaḥ prathame vege paśurdhyāyati duḥkhitaḥ/
lālāsrāvo dvitīye tu kṛṣṇāṅgaḥ† pīḍyate hṛdi//
Su.5.4.43 tṛtīye ca śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇṭhagrīvaṃ ca bhajyate/
caturthe vepate mūḍhaḥ khādan dantān jahātyasūn//
dhyāyati prathame vege pakṣī muhyatyataḥ param//
Su.5.5.5 daheddaṃśamathotkṛtya yatra bandho na jāyate/
sa †daṣṭavyo+athavā sarpo loṣṭo vā+api hi tatkṣaṇam//
Su.5.5.7 atha maṇḍalinā daṣṭaṃ na kathaṃcana dāhayet/
bhavanti nānyathā kṣipraṃ viṣaṃ hanyuḥ sudustaram//
Su.5.5.13 mantrāstvavidhinā proktā hīnā vā svaravarṇataḥ/
Su.5.5.14 samantataḥ sirā daṃśādvidhyettu kuśalo bhiṣak/
śākhāgre vā lalāṭe vā vyadhyāstā viṛte viṣe//
Su.5.5.15 rakte nirhriyamāṇe tu kṛtsnaṃ nirhriyate viṣam/
tadalābhe hitā vā syāt kṛṣṇā valmīkamṛttikā//
Su.5.5.19 dravamanyattu yatkiñcit pītvā pītvā tadudvamet/
prāyo hi vamanenaiva mukhaṃ nirhriyate viṣam//
Su.5.5.20 phaṇināṃ viṣavege tu prathame śoṇitaṃ haret/
Su.5.5.24 kṛtvā kākapadaṃ carma sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ† kṣipet/
Su.5.5.25 agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ dvitīye pāyayeta ca/
Su.5.5.28 pūrve rājimatāṃ vege+alābudhiḥ śoṇitaṃ haret†/
Su.5.5.31 viṣārtānāṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ vidhānaṃ śasyate mṛdu/
Su.5.5.32 triguṇaṃ mahiṣe soṣṭre gavāśve dviguṇaṃ tu tat†/
pradhārya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā tataḥ karma samācaret//
pāyayeta rasaṃ sarpiḥ †śuktaṃ kṣaudraṃ tathā dadhi//
śiro virecayet kṣipraṃ manyāstambhe ca dāruṇe//
Su.5.5.44 tāḍayecca sirāḥ kṣipraṃ tasya śākhālalāṭajāḥ/
Su.5.5.45 kuryāt kākapadākāraṃ vraṇamevaṃ sravanti tāḥ/
saraktaṃ carma māṃsaṃ vā nikṣipeccāsya mūrdhani//
Su.5.5.46 carmavṛkṣakaṣāyaṃ vā †kalkaṃ vā kuśalo bhiṣak/
Su.5.5.48 alpamapyavaśiṣṭaṃ hi bhūyo vegāya kalpate/
Su.5.5.51 dahyāttatra viṣaṃ skannaṃ bhūyo vegāya kalpate/
Su.5.5.52 viṣe hṛtaguṇe dehādyadā doṣaḥ prakupyati/
Su.5.5.56 gāḍhaṃ baddhe+ariṣṭayā pracchite vā tīkṣṇairlepaistadvidhairvā+†avaśiṣṭaiḥ/
śūne gātre klinnamatyarthapūti jñeyaṃ māṃsaṃ tadviṣāt pūti kaṣṭam//
Su.5.5.57 sadyo viddhaṃ nisravet kṛṣṇaraktaṃ pākaṃ yāyāddahyate cāpyabhīkṣṇam/
kṛṣṇībhūtaṃ klinnamatyarthapūti śīrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ yātyajasraṃ kṣatācca//
Su.5.5.58 tṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhrāntidāhau jvaraśca yasya syustaṃ digdhaviddhaṃ vyavasyet/
pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvametajjuṣṭaṃ yasyālaṃ viṣeṇa vraṇāḥ syuḥ//
Su.5.5.59 lūtādaṣṭā digdhaviddhā viṣairvā juṣṭā prāyaste vraṇāḥ pūtimāṃsāḥ†/
teṣāṃ yuktyā pūtimāṃsānyapohya vāryokobhiḥ śoṇitaṃ cāpahṛtya//
Su.5.5.60 hṛtvā doṣān kṣipramūrdhvaṃ tvadhaśca samyak siñcet kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyaiḥ/
Su.5.5.61 bhinne tvasthnā duṣṭajātena kāryaḥ pūrvo mārgaḥ paittike yo viṣe ca/
trivṛdviśalye madhukaṃ haridre raktā narendro lavaṇaśca vargaḥ//
Su.5.5.62 kaṭutrikaṃ caiva sucūrṇitāni śṛṅge nidadhyānmadhusaṃyutāni/
Su.5.5.63 avāryavīryo viṣavegahantā† mahāgado nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ/
Su.5.5.64 sarvaśca vargo lavaṇaḥ susūkṣmaḥ sacitrakaḥ kṣaudrayuto nidheyaḥ/
śṛṅge gavāṃ śṛṅgamayena caiva pracchāditaḥ pakṣamupekṣitaśca//
Su.5.5.65 eṣo+agadaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ jetā† viṣāṇāmajito hi nāmnā/
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ suradāru mustā kālānusāryā kaṭurohiṇī ca//
Su.5.5.67 rodhraṃ jalaṃ kāñcanagairikaṃ ca samāgadhaṃ candanasaindhavaṃ ca/
sūkṣmāṇi cūrṇāni samāni kṛtvā śṛṅge nidadhyānmadhusaṃyutāni//
Su.5.5.68 eṣo+agadastārkṣya iti pradiṣṭo viṣaṃ nihanyādapi takṣakasya/
bhārgī paṭolaṃ kiṇihī sapāṭhā mṛgādanī karkaṭikā puraśca//
Su.5.5.70 pālindyaśokau kramukaṃ surasyāḥ prasūnamāruṣkarajaṃ ca puṣpam/
sūkṣmāni cūrṇāni samāni śṛṅge nyaset sapittāni samākṣikāṇi†//
yasyāgado+ayaṃ sukṛto gṛhe syānnamnarṣabho nāma nararṣabhasya//
Su.5.5.72 na tatra sarpāḥ kuta eva kīṭāstyajanti vīryāṇi viṣāṇi caiva/
etena bheryaḥ paṭahāśca digdhā nānadyamānā viṣamāśu hanyuḥ//
Su.5.5.73 digdhāḥ patākāśca nirīkṣya sadyo viṣābhibhūtā hyaviṣā bhavanti/
Su.5.5.75 saṃjīvano nāma gatāsukalpāneṣo+agado jīvayatīha martyān/
śleṣmātakīkaṭphalamātuluṅgyaḥ śvetā girihvā kiṇihī sitā ca//
Su.5.5.76 sataṇḍulīyo+agada eṣa mukhyo viṣeṣu darvīkararājilānām/
drākṣā sugandhā nagavṛttikā ca śvetā †samaṅgā samabhāgayuktā//
Su.5.5.77 deyo dvibhāgaḥ surasācchadasya kapitthabilvādapi dāḍimācca/
Su.5.5.78 eṣo+agadaḥ kṣaudrayuto nihanti viśeṣato maṇḍalināṃ viṣāṇi/
Su.5.5.79 karañjabījaṃ tagaraṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ ca gopittayutaṃ nihanti/
kācārmakothān paṭalāṃśca ghorān puṣpaṃ ca hantyañjananasyayogaiḥ//
salāvaṇaḥ kṣaudrayuto+atha pīto viśeṣataḥ kīṭaviṣaṃ nihanti//
Su.5.5.82 kuṣṭhaṃ trikaṭukaṃ dārvī madhukaṃ lavaṇadvayam/
mālatī nāgapuṣpaṃ ca sarvāṇi madhurāṇi ca//
Su.5.5.86 bhūmī kurabakaścaiva gaṇa ekasaraḥ smṛtaḥ/
Su.5.6.4 anena dundubhiṃ limpet patākāṃ toraṇāni ca/
Su.5.6.5 eṣa kṣārāgado nāma śarkarāsvaśmarīṣu ca/
Su.5.6.6 ajīrṇe grahaṇīdoṣe bhaktadveṣe† ca dāruṇe/
†śophe sarvasare cāpi deyaḥ śvāse ca dāruṇe//
Su.5.6.9 dāḍimaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ rajanyau sārive sthire/
Su.5.6.12 apāmārgasya bījāni śirīṣasya ca māṣakān/
śvete dve kākamācīṃ ca gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet//
Su.5.6.15 bhadraśriyaṃ yavaphalāṃ bhārgīṃ nīlīṃ sugandhikām/
Su.5.6.19 uśīraṃ varuṇaṃ mustaṃ kustumburu nakhaṃ tathā/
śvete haridre sthauṇeyaṃ lākṣāṃ ca lavaṇāni ca//
Su.5.6.23 etat saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ sūkṣmacūrṇāni† kārayet/
rājā+agadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rājño haste bhavet sadā//
Su.5.6.28 uṣṇavarjyo vidhiḥ kāryo viṣārtānāṃ vijānatā/
Su.5.6.31 divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ krodhamātapam/
Su.5.7.3 pūrvaṃ śukraviṣā uktā bhūṣikā ye samāsataḥ/
Su.5.7.4 lālanaḥ putrakaḥ kṛṣṇo haṃsiraścikviras(haṃsiraścikkiras) tathā/
Su.5.7.6 śvetena mahatā sārdhaṃ kapilenākhunā tathā/
Su.5.7.7 śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ† spṛśanti vā/
Su.5.7.8 jāyante granthayaḥ śophāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca/
Su.5.7.14 haṃsireṇānnavidveṣo jṛmbhā romṇāṃ ca harṣaṇam/
Su.5.7.15 cikvireṇa(cikkireṇa) śiroduḥkhaṃ śopho hikkā vamistathā/
cavyaṃ harītakī śuṇṭhī viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī madhu//
Su.5.7.18 aṅkoṭhabījaṃ ca tathā pibedatra viṣāpaham/
Su.5.7.21 sahe sasindhuvāre ca lihyāttatra samākṣike/
Su.5.7.22 snukkṣīrapiṣṭāṃ pālindīṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhunā lihet/
kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro granthyudgamaḥ satṛṭ//
Su.5.7.24 lihyānmadhuyutāṃ śvetāṃ śvetāṃ cāpi punarnavām/
Su.5.7.26 mahākṛṣṇena pittaṃ ca śvetena kapha eva ca/
Su.5.7.29 niṣkvāthya caiṣāṃ kvāthasya caturtho+aṃśaḥ punarbhavet/
Su.5.7.32 sirāśca †srāvayet prāptāḥ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca/
sarveṣāṃ ca vidhiḥ kāryo mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣeṣvayam//
Su.5.7.33 dagdhvā visrāvayeddaṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet/
Su.5.7.35 devadālīphalaṃ caiva dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet/
Su.5.7.36 phalaṃ vacā devadālī kuṣṭhaṃ gomūtrapeṣitam/
Su.5.7.42 sthirāṇāṃ rujatāṃ vā+api vraṇānāṃ karṇikāṃ bhiṣak/
Su.5.7.45 tenonmattena daṣṭasya daṃṣṭriṇā saviṣeṇa tu/
yena cāpi bhaveddaṣṭastasya ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ//
daṃṣṭriṇā yena daṣṭaśca tadrūpaṃ yastu paśyati//
Su.5.7.48 †apsu vā yadi vā++ādarśo+ariṣṭaṃ tasya vinirdiśet/
Su.5.7.49 jalatrāsaṃ tu vidyāttaṃ riṣṭaṃ †tadapi kīrtitam/
adaṣṭo vā jalatrāsī na kathañcana sidhyati//
Su.5.7.50 prasupto+athotthito vā+api svasthastrasto na sidhyati/
Su.5.7.51 pradihyādagadaiḥ sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pāyayeta ca/
palalaṃ tilatailaṃ ca rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ//
Su.5.7.56 vikārāḥ śiśire yāpyā gṛhe vārivivarjite/
kupyet svayaṃ viṣaṃ yasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ//
Su.5.7.59 tasmāt prakopayedāśu svayaṃ yāvat† prakupyati/
baliṃ nivedya tatrāpi piṇyākaṃ palalaṃ dadhi//
Su.5.7.61 mālyāni ca vicitrāṇi māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā/
Su.5.7.63 aśuddhasya surūḍhe+api vraṇe kupyati tadviṣam/
Su.5.7.64 ataḥ karoti daṣṭastu teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ/
bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇo na cirānmriyate ca saḥ//
Su.5.8.14 kīṭo gardabhakaścaiva† tathā troṭaka eva ca/
Su.5.8.18 tāstāśca vedanāstīvrā rogā vai sānnipātikāḥ/
Su.5.8.20 vepathuśvāsahikkāśca dāhaḥ śītaṃ ca dāruṇam/
Su.5.8.21 dadravaḥ karṇikāścaiva visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca/
Su.5.8.22 ye+anye teṣāṃ viśeṣāstu tūrṇaṃ teṣāṃ samādiśet/
Su.5.8.27 tairdaṣṭasya śvayathuraṅgamardo gurutā gātrāṇāṃ daṃśaḥ kṛṣṇaśca bhavati//
Su.5.8.28 †pratisūryakaḥ, piṅgābhāso, bahuvarṇo, †nirūpamo godhereka iti pañca godherakāḥ†; tairdaṣṭasya śopho dāharujau ca bhavataḥ, godherakeṇaitadeva granthiprādurbhāvo jvaraśca//

Su.5.8.29 †galagolikā śvetā, kṛṣṇā, raktarājī, raktamaṇḍalā, sarvaśvetā, sarṣapiketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe sarṣapikāvarjaṃ dāhaśophakledā bhavanti, sarṣapikayā hṛdayapiḍā+atisāraśca, tāsu madhye sarṣapikā prāṇaharī//

Su.5.8.30 śatapadyastu paruṣā, kṛṣṇā, citrā, kapilā, pītikā, raktā, śvetā, agniprabhā, ityaṣṭau; tābhirdaṣṭe śopho vedanā dāhaśca hṛdaye, śvetāgniprabhābhyāmetadeva dāho mūrcchā cātimātraṃ śvetapiḍakotpattiśca//

Su.5.8.31 maṇḍūkāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, sāraḥ, kuhako, harito, rakto, yavavarṇābho, bhṛkuṭī, koṭikaścetyaṣṭau; tairdaṣṭasya daṃśe kaṇḍūrbhavati pītaphenāgamaśca vaktrāt, bhṛkuṭīkoṭikābhyāmetadeva dāhaśchardirmūrcchā cātimātram//
Su.5.8.32 viśvambharābhirdaṣṭe daṃśaḥ sarṣapākārābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ sarujābhiścīyate, śītajvarārtaśca puruṣo bhavati//

Su.5.8.33 ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭe todadāhakaṇḍuścayathavo bhavanti mohaśca; kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭe pītāṅgaśchardyatīsārajvarādibhirabhihanyate; śūkavṛntābhirdaṣṭe kaṇḍūkoṭhāḥ pravardhante śūkaṃ cātra lakṣyate//
Su.5.8.34 pipīlikāḥ sthūlaśīrṣā, saṃvāhikā, brahmaṇikā, aṅgulikā; kapilikā, citravarṇeti ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe† daṃśe śvayathuragnisparśavaddāhaśophau bhavataḥ//

Su.5.8.35 makṣikāḥ kāntārikā, kṛṣṇā, piṅgalā, madhūlikā, kāṣāyī, sthāliketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭasya kaṇḍuśophadāharujo bhavanti, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva śyāvapiḍakotpattirupadravāśca jvarādayo bhavanti, kāṣāyī sthālikā ca prāṇahare†//
Su.5.8.36 maśakāḥ sāmudraḥ, parimaṇḍalo, hastimaśakaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, pārvatīya iti pañca; tairdaṣṭasya tīvrā kaṇḍūrdaṃśaśophaśca, pārvatīyastu kīṭaiḥ prāṇaharaistulyalakṣaṇaḥ//
Su.5.8.38 bhavanti cātra godherakaḥ sthālikā ca ye ca śvetāgnisaprabhe/
trividhānāṃ tu pūrveṣāṃ† traividhyena kriyā hitāḥ//
Su.5.8.44 viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ †bahuśaḥ śodhanāni ca/
utkārikā sthirādau vā sukṛtā svedane hitā//
Su.5.8.46 na svedayeta cādaṃśaṃ dhūmaṃ vakṣyāmi vṛścike/
Su.5.8.47 kuṣṭhaṃ vakraṃ vacā pāṭhā bilvamūlaṃ suvarcikā/
Su.5.8.49 kuṅkumaṃ tagaraṃ śigru padmakaṃ rajanīdvayam/
Su.5.8.50 meṣaśṛṅgī vacā pāṭhā niculo rohiṇī jalam/
Su.5.8.52 śirīṣaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāliparṇī sahā niśe/
Su.5.8.53 kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭānāṃ rātrau śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ/
Su.5.8.58 mandā dvādaśa madhyāstu trayaḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ/
Su.5.8.59 kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvaḥ karburaḥ †pāṇḍuvarṇo gomūtrābhaḥ †karkaśo mecakaśca/
†pīto dhūmro romaśaḥ śāḍvalābho raktaḥ śvetenodareṇeti mandāḥ†//
Su.5.8.60 yuktāścaite vṛścikāḥ pucchadeśe syurbhūyobhiḥ parvabhiścetarebhyaḥ/
Su.5.8.61 śākhādaṣṭe vedanā cordhvameti dāhasvedau daṃśaśopho jvaraśca/
raktaḥ pītaḥ kāpilenodareṇa sarve dhūmrāḥ parvabhiśca tribhiḥ syuḥ//
yasyaiteṣāmanvayādyaḥ prasūto doṣotpattiṃ tatsvarūpāṃ sa kuryāt//
śvetaścitraḥ śyāmalo lohitābho† raktaḥ śveto raktanīlodarau ca//
Su.5.8.64 †pīto+arakto nīlapīto+aparastu rakto nīlo nīlaśuklastathā ca/
rakto babhruḥ pūrvavaccaikaparvā yaścāparvā parvaṇī dve ca yasya//
Su.5.8.65 nānārūpā varṇataścāpi ghorā jñeyāścaite vṛścikāḥ prāṇacaurāḥ†/
janmaiteṣāṃ sarpakothāt pradiṣṭaṃ dehebhyo vā ghātitānāṃ viṣeṇa//
khebhyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ yāti tīvraṃ tasmāt† prāṇaistyajyate śīghrameva//
Su.5.8.69 lepe svede sukhoṣṇaṃ ca gomayaṃ hitamiṣyate/
Su.5.8.70 daṃśaṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ tu cakratailena secayet/
Su.5.8.72 pānamasmai pradātavyaṃ kṣīraṃ vā saguḍaṃ himam/
Su.5.8.73 dhūmo hanti prayuktastu śīghraṃ vṛścikajaṃ viṣam/
kusumbhapuṣpaṃ rajanī niśā vā kodravaṃ tṛṇam//
Su.5.8.75 lūtāviṣaṃ ghoratamaṃ durvijñeyatamaṃ ca tat/
Su.5.8.77 agadānāṃ hi saṃyogo viṣajuṣṭasya yujyate/
Su.5.8.79 prodbhidyamānastu yathā+aṅkureṇa na vyaktajātiḥ pravibhāti vṛkṣaḥ/
tadvaddurālakṣyatamaṃ hi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ śarīre pravikīrṇamātram//
Su.5.8.80 īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalaṃ sakoṭhamavyaktavarṇaṃ prathame+ahani syāt/
anteṣu śūnaṃ parinimnamadhyaṃ pravyaktarūpaṃ ca dine dvitīye//
Su.5.8.81 tryaheṇa taddarśayatīha rūpaṃ viṣaṃ caturthe+ahani kopameti/
Su.5.8.82 ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśamāvṛṇoti/
Su.5.8.83 yāstīkṣṇacaṇḍograviṣā hi lūtāstāḥ saptarātreṇa naraṃ nihanyuḥ/
Su.5.8.84 yāsāṃ kanīyo viṣavīryamuktaṃ tāḥ pakṣamātreṇa vināśayanti/
Su.5.8.86 sakaṇḍukoṭhaṃ sthiramalpamūlaṃ lālākṛtaṃ mandarujaṃ vadanti/
śophaśca kaṇḍūśca pulālikā† ca dhūmāyanaṃ caiva nakhāgradaṃśe//
Su.5.8.87 daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇa sakṛṣṇamadhyaṃ saraktaparyanmavehi dīrṇam/
daṃṣṭrābhirugraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vivarṇaṃ jānīhi daṃśaṃ sthiramaṇḍalaṃ ca//
Su.5.8.88 rajaḥpurīṣendriyajaṃ hi viddhi sphoṭaṃ vipakvāmalapīlupāṇḍum/
etāvadetat samudāhṛtaṃ tu vakṣyāmi lūtāprabhavaṃ purāṇam//
Su.5.8.89 sāmānyato daṣṭamasādhyasādhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāpi yathāviśeṣam/
Su.5.8.92 tṛṇe maharṣiṇā lūne dhenvarthaṃ saṃbhṛte+api ca/
Su.5.8.93 yasmāllūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptā muneḥ prasvedabindavaḥ/
Su.5.8.95 trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā pītikā tathā/
Su.5.8.96 tābhirdaṣṭe śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇḍūrdaṃśe ca vedanā/
Su.5.8.98 tābhirdaṣṭe daṃśakothaḥ pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasya ca/
Su.5.8.99 piḍakā vividhākārā maṇḍalāni mahānti ca/
Su.5.8.101 trimaṇḍalāyā daṃśe+asṛk kṛṣṇaṃ sravati dīryate/
Su.5.8.103 śvetāyāḥ piḍakā daṃśe śvetā kaṇḍūmatī bhavet/
kuṣṭhaṃ lāmajjakaṃ vakraṃ naladaṃ cāgado hitaḥ//
Su.5.8.105 ādaṃśe piḍakā tāmrā kapilāyāḥ sthirā bhavet/
śiraso gauravaṃ dāhastimiraṃ bhrama eva ca//
Su.5.8.107 ādaṃśe pītikāyāstu piḍakā pītikā sthirā/
Su.5.8.109 raktamaṇḍanibhe daṃśe piḍakāḥ sarṣapā iva/
Su.5.8.116 purīṣagandhiralpāsṛk kṛṣṇāyā daṃśa eva tu/
Su.5.8.121 kṛcchrasādhyaviṣā hyaṣṭau proktā dve ca yadṛcchayā/
śvāsaḥ kāso jvarastṛṣṇā mūrcchā cātra sudāruṇā//
Su.5.8.123 ādaṃśe lājavarṇāyā dhyāmaṃ pūti sravedasṛk/
Su.5.8.132 sārivāṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ payasyāṃ kṣīramoraṭam/
Su.5.8.133 kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyeṇa suśītena ca secayet/
Su.5.8.136 vinivṛtte tataḥ śophe karṇikāpātanaṃ hitam/
Su.5.8.137 gugguluḥ saindhavaṃ kiṇvaṃ varcaḥ pārāvatasya ca/
Su.5.8.138 viṣebhyaḥ khalu sarvebhyaḥ karṇikāmarujāṃ sthirām/
Su.6.1.6 ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu ye coktāḥ paramarṣibhiḥ/
Su.6.1.7 triṣaṣṭī rasasaṃsargāḥ svasthavṛttaṃ tathaiva ca/
palaṃ bhuvo+agnito raktaṃ vātāt kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ jalāt//
dṛṣṭiṃ cātra tathā vakṣye yathā brūyādviśāradaḥ//
Su.6.1.14 maṇḍalāni ca sandhīṃśca paṭalāni ca locane/
yathākramaṃ vijānīyāt pañca ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca//
sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kālakasya ca//
Su.6.1.20 guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane+akṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ/
Su.6.1.23 vihanyamānaṃ rūpe vā kriyāsvakṣi yathā purā/
dṛṣṭvaiva dhīmān budhyeta doṣeṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tu tat//
bāṣpagrahāt sūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ//
Su.6.1.28 vātāddaśa tathā pittāt kaphāccaiva trayodaśa/
Su.6.1.29 tathā bāhyau punardvau ca rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ/
Su.6.1.30 yacca vātahataṃ vartma na te sidhyanti vātajāḥ/
Su.6.1.32 parimlāyī ca nīlaśca yāpyaḥ kāco+atha tanmayaḥ/
Su.6.1.33 dṛṣṭiḥ pittavidagdhā ca dhūmadarśī ca sidhyati/
asādhyaḥ kaphajaḥ srāvo yāpyaḥ kācaśca tanmayaḥ//
dṛṣṭiḥ śleṣmavidagdhā ca pothakyo lagaṇaśca yaḥ//
śukraṃ na sādhyaṃ kācaśca yāpyastajjaḥ prakīrtitaḥ//
sirājātā+añjanākhyā ca sirājālaṃ ca yat smṛtam//
ete sādhyā vikāreṣu raktajeṣu bhavanti hi//
asādhyāḥ sarvajā yāpyaḥ kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇaḥ//
Su.6.1.40 vartmāvabandho yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā/
Su.6.1.45 sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu/
Su.6.2.4 pakvaḥ śophaḥ sandhijaḥ saṃsravedyaḥ sāndraṃ pūyaṃ pūti pūyālasaḥ saḥ/
Su.6.2.5 gatvā sandhīnaśrumārgeṇa doṣāḥ kuryuḥ srāvān rugvihīnān kanīnāt/
tān vai srāvān netranāḍīmathaike tasyā liṅgaṃ kīrtayiṣye caturdhā//
Su.6.2.6 pākaḥ sandhau saṃsravedyaśca pūyaṃ pūyāsrāvo naikarūpaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ/
śvetaṃ sāndraṃ picchilaṃ saṃsravedyaḥ śleṣmāsrāvo nīrujaḥ sa pradiṣṭaḥ//
Su.6.2.7 raktāsrāvaḥ śoṇitotthaḥ saraktamuṣṇaṃ nālpaṃ saṃsravennātisāndram/
pītābhāsaṃ nīlamuṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittāsrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt//
Su.6.2.8 tāmrā tanvī dāhaśūlopapannā raktājjñeyā parvaṇī vṛttaśophā/
jātā sandhau kṛṣṇaśukle+alajī syāttasminneva khyāpitā pūrvaliṅgaiḥ//
Su.6.2.9 krimigranthirvartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaśca kaṇḍūṃ kuryuḥ krimayaḥ sandhijātāḥ/
Su.6.3.3 pṛthagdoṣāḥ samastā vā yadā vartmavyapāśrayāḥ/
Su.6.3.4 †vivardhya māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca tadā vartmavyapāśrayān/
Su.6.3.7 praklinnamapariklinnaṃ vartma vātahataṃ tu yat/
Su.6.3.8 lagaṇo biśanāmā ca pakṣmakopastathaiva ca/
piḍakā yā kharā sthūlā sā jñeyā vartmaśarkarā//
Su.6.3.14 dīrgho+aṅkuraḥ kharaḥ stabdho dāruṇo vartmasaṃbhavaḥ/
na samaṃ chādayedakṣi bhavedbandhaḥ sa vartmanaḥ//
Su.6.3.18 mṛdvalpavedanaṃ tāmraṃ yadvartma samameva ca/
Su.6.3.19 kliṣṭaṃ punaḥ pittayutaṃ vidahecchoṇitaṃ yadā/
Su.6.3.20 yadvartma bāhyato+anyaśca śyāvaṃ śūnaṃ savedanam/
Su.6.3.21 arujaṃ bāhyataḥ śūnamantaḥ klinnaṃ sravatyapi/
Su.6.3.22 yasya dhautāni dhautāni saṃbadhyante punaḥ punaḥ/
Su.6.3.23 vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ vartma yasya na mīlyate/
Su.6.3.25 nimeṣaṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ/
Su.6.3.28 śūnaṃ yadvartma bahubhiḥ sūkṣmaiśchidraiḥ samanvitam/
syuḥ śuktikā cārjunapiṣṭakau ca jālaṃ sirāṇāṃ piḍakāśca yāḥ syuḥ//
Su.6.4.4 rogā balāsagrathitena sārdhamekādaśākṣṇoḥ khalu śuklabhāge/
prastāri prathitamihārma śuklabhāge vistīrṇaṃ tanu rudhiraprabhaṃ sanīlam//
Su.6.4.5 śuklākhyaṃ mṛdu kathayanti śuklabhāge saśvetaṃ samamiha† vardhate cireṇa/
yanmāṃsaṃ pracayamupaiti śuklabhāge padmābhaṃ tadupadiśanti lohitārma//
Su.6.4.6 vistīrṇaṃ mṛdu bahalaṃ yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā tadadhikamāṃsajārma vidyāt/
śukle yat piśitamupaiti vṛddhimetat snāyvarmetyabhipaṭhitaṃ kharaṃ prapāṇḍu//
Su.6.4.7 śyāvāḥ syuḥ piśitanibhāśca bindavo ye śuktyābhāḥ sitanayane sa śuktisaṃjñaḥ/
eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamastu binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tamarjunaṃ vadanti//
Su.6.4.8 utsannaḥ salilanibho+atha piṣṭaśuklo binduryo bhavati sa piṣṭakaḥ suvṛttaḥ/
jālābhaḥ kaṭhinasiro mahān saraktaḥ santānaḥ smṛta iha jālasaṃjñitastu//
Su.6.4.9 śuklasthāḥ sitapiḍakāḥ sirāvṛtā yāstā vidyādasitasamīpajāḥ sirājāḥ/
kāṃsyābho† bhavati site+ambubindutulyaḥ sa jñeyo+amṛdurarujo balāsakākhyaḥ//
Su.6.5.3 yat savraṇaṃ śukla(śukra)mathāvraṇaṃ vā pākātyayaścāpyajakā tathaiva/
catvāra ete+abhihitā vikārāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayāḥ saṃgrahataḥ purastāt//
Su.6.5.4 nimagnarūpaṃ hi bhavettu kṛṣṇe sūcyeva viddhaṃ pratibhāti †yadvai/
srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamatīva ruk ca tat savraṇaṃ śukra(śukla)mudāharanti//
Su.6.5.5 dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavettu yacca na cāvagāḍhaṃ na ca saṃsraveddhi/
Su.6.5.6 vicchinnamadhyaṃ piśitāvṛtaṃ vā calaṃ sirāsaktamadṛṣṭikṛcca†/
Su.6.5.7 uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā ca kṛṣṇe yasmin bhavenmudganibhaṃ ca śukram/
Su.6.5.8 sitaṃ yadā bhātyasitapradeśe syandātmakaṃ nātirugaśruyuktam/
Su.6.5.9 gambhīrajātaṃ bahalaṃ ca śukraṃ cirotthitaṃ cāpi vadanti kṛcchram/
saṃcchādyate† śvetanibhena sarvaṃ doṣeṇa yasyāsitamaṇḍalaṃ tu//
vidārya kṛṣṇaṃ pracayo+abhyupaiti taṃ cājakājātamiti vyavasyet//
Su.6.6.3 syandāstu catvāra ihopadiṣṭāstāvanta eveha tathā+adhimanthāḥ/
viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca vātābhipanne nayane bhavanti//
uṣṇāśrutā pītakanetratā ca pittābhipanne nayane bhavanti//
srāvo muhuḥ picchila eva cāpi kaphābhipanne nayane bhavanti//
Su.6.6.9 tāmrāśrutā lohitanetratā ca rājyaḥ samantādatilohitāśca/
pittasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni raktābhipanne nayane bhavanti//
Su.6.6.11 utpāṭyata ivātyarthaṃ netraṃ nirmathyate tathā/
śiraso+ardhaṃ ca yena syādadhimanthaḥ sa mārutāt//
ṣaḍrātrādvau mārutottho nihanyānmithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva//
rujābhirugrābhirasādhya eṣa hatādhimanthaḥ khalu nāma rogaḥ//
Su.6.6.24 antaḥsirāṇāṃ śvasanaḥ sthito dṛṣṭiṃ pratikṣipan/
Su.6.6.26 yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma vilokane cāviladarśanaṃ yat/
sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi//
Su.6.6.28 amlena bhuktena vidāhinā ca saṃchādyate sarvata eva netram/
Su.6.6.29 avedanā vā+api savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ/
muhurvirajyanti ca tāḥ samantād vyādhiḥ sirotpāta iti pradiṣṭaḥ//
Su.6.6.30 mohāt sirotpāta upekṣitastu jāyeta rogastu sirāpraharṣaḥ/
tāmrācchamasraṃ† sravati pragāḍhaṃ tathā na śaknotyabhivīkṣituṃ ca//
Su.6.7.5 rogāṃstadāśrayān ghorān ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca pracakṣmahe/
prathame paṭale doṣo yasya dṛṣṭau vyavathitaḥ//
Su.6.7.7 avyaktāni sa rūpāṇi sarvāṇyeva prapaśyati/
Su.6.7.8 makṣikā maśakān keśāñjālakāni ca paśyati/
Su.6.7.11 ūrdhvaṃ paśyati gādhastāttṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate/
pārśvasthite tathā doṣe pārśvasthāni na paśyati//
Su.6.7.14 samantataḥ sthite doṣe saṅkulānīva† paśyati/
dṛṣṭimadhyagate doṣe sa ekaṃ manyate dvidhā//
timirākhyaḥ sa vai doṣaḥ caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ//
Su.6.7.16 ruṇaddhi sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ liṅganāśaḥ sa ucyate/
nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi bhrājiṣṇūni† ca paśyati//
tatra vātena rūpāṇi bhramantīva sa paśyati//
kaphena paśyedrūpāṇi snigdhāni ca sitāni ca//
Su.6.7.22 salilaplāvitānīva parijāḍyāni mānavaḥ// tathā raktena raktāni tamāṃsi vividhāni ca//
Su.6.7.24 bahudhā vā dvidhā vā+api sarvāṇyeva samantataḥ/
Su.6.7.25 pittaṃ kuryāt parimlāyi mūrcchitaṃ raktatejasā/
Su.6.7.27 rāgo+aruṇo mārutajaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pittāt parimlāyyathavā+api nīlaḥ/
kaphāt sitaḥ śoṇitajastu raktaḥ samastadoṣo+atha vicitrarūpaḥ†//
Su.6.7.29 doṣakṣayāt kadācit syātsvayaṃ tatra ca darśanam/
Su.6.7.32 mṛdyamāne ca nayane maṇḍalaṃ tadvisarpati/
Su.6.7.34 ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ ṣaḍime ca rogā dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca syuḥ/
tathā naraḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ kaphena cānyastvatha dhūmadarśī//
Su.6.7.35 yo hrasvajāḍyo†(hrasvajātyo) nakulāndhatā ca gambhīrasaṃjñā ca tathaiva dṛṣṭiḥ/
pittena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ pītā bhavedyasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ//
Su.6.7.36 pītāni rūpāṇi ca manyate yaḥ sa mānavaḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ/
prāpte tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ tu doṣe divā na paśyenniśi vīkṣate ca//
Su.6.7.37 (†rātrau sa śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvādapi tāni paśyet)/
tathā naraḥ śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭistānyeva śuklāni hi manyate tu//
Su.6.7.38 triṣu sthitolpaḥ paṭaleṣu doṣo naktāndhyamāpādayati prasahya/
sadhūmakān paśyati sarvabhāvāṃstaṃ dhūmadarśīti vadanti rogam//
Su.6.7.40 sa †hrasvajāḍyo divaseṣu kṛcchrāddhrasvāni rūpāṇi ca yena paśyet/
vidyotate yena narasya dṛṣṭirdoṣābhipannā nakulasya yadvat//
Su.6.7.41 citrāṇi rūpāṇi divā sa paśyet sa vai vikāro nakulāndhyasaṃjñaḥ/
Su.6.7.42 rujāvagāḍhā ca tamakṣirogaṃ gambhīriketi pravadanti tajjñāḥ/
Su.6.7.44 hanyeta dṛṣṭirmanujasya yasya sa liṅganāśastvanimittasaṃjñaḥ/
tatrākṣi vispaṣṭamivāvabhāti vaidūryavarṇā vimalā ca dṛṣṭiḥ//
Su.6.7.45 vidīryate sīdati hīyate vā nṛṇāmabhīghātahatā tu dṛṣṭiḥ//
Su.6.7.46 ityete nayanagatā mayā vikārāḥ saṃkhyātāḥ pṛthagiha ṣaṭ ca saptatiśca/
eteṣāṃ pṛthagiha vistareṇa sarvaṃ vakṣye+ahaṃ tadanu cikitsitaṃ yathāvat//
Su.6.8.4 chedyāsteṣu daśaikaśca nava lekhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ/
bhedyāḥ pañca vikārāḥ syurvyadhyāḥ pañcadaśaiva tu//
Su.6.8.5 dvādaśā+aśastrakṛtyāśca yāpyāḥ sapta bhavanti hi/
rogā varjayitavyāḥ syurdaśa pañca ca jānatā/
